added.title: AI/ML Engineer
added.description:
Who We’re Looking For

We are revolutionizing construction site documentation through computer vision and AI-driven insights. Our platform enables intuitive navigation of job sites, facilitates seamless collaboration between field and office teams, and integrates with industry-leading project management tools.

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will leverage our extensive data lake to architect and deploy cutting-edge machine learning models that turn raw data into actionable intelligence. You will develop modern AI-driven solutions to provide customers with seamless, data-rich insights for enhanced jobsite understanding and collaboration. By building and optimizing high-performance ML pipelines, you will play a critical role in scaling our platform's capabilities and ensuring our system remains a leader in construction technology innovation.

What You’ll Be Doing

The primary responsibilities for our next AI / ML Engineer will be to:

Demonstrate proficiency in machine learning frameworks and apply them to develop robust AI solutions.
Use and adapt existing VLMs, LLMs, generative AI, RAG architectures, and agents to solve complex construction site challenges.
Lead data curation and conduct rigorous data quality assessments to prepare datasets for continuous, automated model updates and improvements.
Collaborate within an agile, multifaceted team to deploy solutions in a cloud environment, enabling fast prototyping and iteration.
Take the lead and proactive ownership of your assigned components, from conception through production deployment and monitoring.
Demonstrate leadership by driving decisions, providing technical direction, mentoring team members, and fostering collaboration across teams and disciplines.

At Fieldwire, we’re looking for our next AI / ML Engineer to have the following skills and experiences

MSc or PhD in a relevant technical discipline, ideally combined with at least 5 years of experience leading AI/ML and optionally CV projects and providing technical direction to engineering teams.
Strong hands-on technical expertise, demonstrated through successfully designing, building, training, and deploying AI/ML solutions or products in production environments.
Strong background in Computer Vision (CV), Core Deep Learning, and Neural Architectures.
Experience with modern AI/ML development, such as:

Computer Vision & Perception: Experience developing and deploying advanced vision models for detection, segmentation, and classification to interpret complex visual data.
Multimodal Systems: Ability to integrate and align vision, language, and other sensor data to create intelligent, context-aware applications.
Spatial Intelligence: Familiarity with 3D scene understanding, reconstruction, or geometry-based AI techniques.

Operational Competencies
Proficiency in modern deep learning frameworks and production-grade programming.
Experience optimizing models for performance and efficiency, particularly for resource-constrained environments.
Understanding of deployment pipelines and model optimization for diverse hardware targets.

And if you have any of the following, we
REALLY
want you to apply today!

Highly Motivated & Adaptable: You thrive in dynamic environments. When challenges pop up, you’re the first to step in, adapt, and solve them.
Collaborative Team Player: You’re a natural team player who supports your peers—the kind of hero who steps in exactly when the team needs it most.
Clear Communicator: You excel at bridging the gap between complex technical logic and actionable team insights.
Drive: You approach technical hurdles with the focused determination of a main character in a classic training arc, always ready to power up, break through limits, and deploy your best work.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: $152,000 - $220,000

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. In addition to the salary you may be eligible for a corporate bonus which can range up to 30%.

Why Fieldwire?

The field-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.

Where is the job located?

This role is fully remote within the United States. Our headquarters are based in beautiful San Francisco and our office is centrally located right off of Embarcadero Bart station.

added.title: Senior AI Builder
added.description:
ABOUT EARNIN
As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.
EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products.
As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly.
POSITION SUMMARY

EarnIn is making AI-native engineering a core capability — not an initiative, but how we design, build, and ship. We're not hiring a software engineer who dabbles in AI. We're hiring an AI builder who also writes great software — someone who looks at every step of how we design, build, test, and ship, and asks: why isn't an agent doing this? This is not a side project. The agents and harnesses you build here will run in production, making real decisions for real people — people who depend on EarnIn to access their pay when it matters most. If that bar excites you rather than intimidates you, keep reading.
You'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, developer experience, and applied AI — partnering with architects, domain leads,, and product engineers to build the tools, patterns, and guardrails that make AI adoption fast, safe, and durable. The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $228,000 - $279,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View that requires in-office work 2 days a week. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Agents that take real actions. You'll design how agents think — prompts, reasoning chains, tool calls, and the full architecture beneath them. From MCP servers and agent scaffolding to context harnesses and a Skills Marketplace, you're building the layer every squad at EarnIn builds on. Not a proof of concept. Production infrastructure. 
A PDLC that doesn't look like 2022. The product development lifecycle is overdue for a rethink. You'll challenge each stage — from scoping and design through to review, testing, deployment, and monitoring — and replace manual friction with agentic workflows wherever it makes sense. Evaluation pipelines, automated PR hygiene, deployment gating, generation-to-merge metrics: you'll build the scaffolding that makes governed AI fast, not slow.
Evals that actually mean something. You'll own the evaluation infrastructure — building the pipelines, benchmarks, and quality gates that tell us whether our AI is working, degrading, or ready to ship. That means designing eval harnesses for AI-assisted workflows, setting generation-to-merge and review latency baselines, and making model quality visible and trustworthy across teams. If you've built evals that caught real problems before they hit production, you'll fit right in.
Pilots that graduate to production. EarnIn's engineering leads are running experiments. You'll be the person who takes what's working and turns it into something the next team can fork and ship in a week. Less "interesting prototype," more "thing we rely on." You’ll build reusable libraries, templates, and reference implementations that give squads a running start on AI integration, so no one has to solve the same problem twice

Frontier Medicines is looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to join our AI team in South San Francisco. You'll build the AI systems our scientists use every day: LLM-powered agents that work across our research data, generative models that design new covalent molecules, and predictive models trained on one of the largest proprietary covalent chemistry and chemoproteomics datasets in the industry.

What we're looking for

MS or PhD in computer science, machine learning, computational chemistry, physics, or a related field, or a BS with 2-3 years of equivalent industry or research experience.
A track record of research: publications, preprints, thesis work, or substantial open-source contributions in ML.
Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents, generative models, or multimodal models.
Strong Python and PyTorch skills, and comfort with modern AI coding tools.
The ability to take an open-ended scientific problem and turn it into a working system, independently and collaboratively.
Clear written and verbal communication.
Legal authorization to work in the United States.

Experience with molecular ML, such as GNNs, equivariant models, or molecular representations, or with RDKit and cheminformatics tooling.

Strong understanding of subscription lifecycle and billing processes, including product and pricing models, order changes, invoicing, payments, and collections.
Experience designing integrations between Zuora and enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, payment gateways, tax services, and revenue systems.
Understanding of data models, product and pricing master data, data migration, and data governance.
Knowledge of revenue recognition, financial reporting, and ERP integration; hands-on experience is a plus.
Experience with B2B or B2C e-commerce and subscription business models is highly desired.
Ability to assess architecture tradeoffs, manage dependencies, and communicate risks and recommendations clearly.
Demonstrated ability to work across client, business, and technical teams; influence stakeholders; and guide delivery in a changing environment.
Strong client-facing written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Zuora certifications are a plus, or the ability to earn relevant certifications within the first several months of employment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

added.title: Senior Forward Deployed Strategist
added.description:
An early-stage, seed-funded San Francisco AI startup is putting a senior strategist in front of Fortune 500 boards to decide which AI agents get built.

This is a client-facing strategy role at a business that designs and deploys custom AI agents inside very large enterprises. You will embed with C-suite and operational teams, work out how their back offices really run, and turn that into clear briefs for the engineers. No coding is required. You will learn AI on live deployments alongside a six-person forward-deployed team, on a flat structure with no levels. The company is growing fast, has more demand than it can serve, and new hires will have a genuine say in the playbooks and frameworks.
Role: Senior Forward Deployed Strategist
Salary: $175,000 to $250,000 base plus competitive equity
Location: San Francisco Financial District, on-site 5 days a week, with 20 to 40% travel to client sites across the US

What you’ll be doing:

Run process-mapping sessions and stakeholder interviews inside large enterprise clients
Sit with everyone from the C-suite to operators on the ground to understand how work actually gets done
Find the exceptions, workarounds and broken handoffs that standard automation misses
Analyse client data to pinpoint what is broken and scope the work for engineers
Turn your findings into clear agent briefs and business cases
Present to C-suite executives and handle pushback
Work across finance, sales, operations, legal and HR deployments
Work alongside forward-deployed engineers on proofs of concept and production agents, and learn AI as you go
Help shape the team’s playbooks and frameworks as the company scales

What you’ll need:

1 to 6 years of experience as an analyst or associate in investment banking, private equity or a top-tier consultancy, or in strategy or BizOps at a top tech startup, or as a deployment strategist
Strong analytical skills, with confidence working through client data to find the real problem
Comfort presenting to senior executives and holding your ground when challenged
Ability to run stakeholder interviews and map complex processes step by step
Willingness to travel 20 to 40% of the time across the US
Willingness to work from the San Francisco office 5 days a week, plus some weekends during heavy client pushes
Right to work in the US without sponsorship (the client cannot support any visas)

Nice to have:

Exposure to enterprise back-office functions such as finance, sales, ops, legal or HR
Experience in change management or driving adoption inside large organisations
Interest in AI and automation, even without a technical background
Experience in a small, fast-moving team where you shaped how things were done

This role would suit an ambitious analyst or associate from banking, PE, consulting or BizOps who wants to be in the room with Fortune 500 leadership and learn AI by shipping it, rather than advising on it from the sidelines.

added.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Systems Product Management team, you will build the intelligence layer behind Everpure's FlashArray and FlashBlade roadmap decisions. Our platforms generate an extraordinary volume of signal—fleet telemetry from tens of thousands of deployed systems alongside commercial, support, and cost data. Working directly with product managers across the portfolio, you will translate complex, cross-system questions into engineering solutions—leveraging applied AI and fleet-scale data engineering to build production systems that directly shape the hardware we ship.

What You'll Do

Own Engagements End-to-End: Partner directly with product managers to scope ambiguous business questions and carry them from discovery through to a solution running in production.
Design and Build the Platform: Deliver end-to-end capabilities, spanning data and orchestration layers through to the interfaces product managers actively use.
Build for Trust: Maintain high engineering standards so product managers can confidently stake critical roadmap decisions on system output.
Turn One-Offs into Capability: Convert bespoke, hard-won analyses into durable platform capabilities that continuously expand self-service intelligence.
Strengthen the Data Foundation: Identify gaps where existing data cannot answer strategic questions, partnering with data owners across the organization to close them.

What You Bring

Production Engineering Craft: Strong, hands-on Python experience designing, building, and operating software in production—including HTTP APIs, relational schema design and migrations, containerized cloud deployments, version control, CI/CD, testing discipline, and frontend capability to build usable interfaces.
Data Judgment at Scale: Advanced SQL proficiency with large analytical datasets (e.g., Snowflake) and the business acumen to evaluate data integrity, understanding which strategic questions data can accurately answer.
Applied AI Experience: Proven experience shipping LLM-backed or agentic systems to real users, combined with rigorous evaluation practices that maintain system integrity as it evolves.
Communication and Influence: Ability to collaborate with non-technical stakeholders to define tractable engineering problems, exercise technical judgment, and communicate system readiness with credibility.
Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

added.title: Senior Generative AI Engineer
added.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

The Generative and Agentic AI Engineering Department works across the full range of US Government agencies to develop, engineer, and deploy advanced AI capabilities that address complex mission needs for our sponsors. Our department applies generative AI, agentic AI, and AI/ML research and engineering to operational challenges while researching, prototyping, and transitioning innovative technologies to support critical mission objectives for our sponsors. Our work spans generative AI applications, agentic AI system design, AI model fine-tuning and adaptation, knowledge representation and extraction, AI architectures, MLOps/LLMOps, and human language technology (HLT). The department maintains deep expertise in large language models, agentic AI, autonomous AI workflows and data processing pipelines, computational linguistics, knowledge graph construction, identity resolution and AI/GenAI evaluation.

Roles & Responsibilities:

The position involves researching, developing, evaluating, and integrating generative AI and agentic AI capabilities. Specific responsibilities will include:

Work in and provide technical leadership to cross-functional teams to develop and implement AI solutions, including prototype implementation of capabilities that leverage generative AI, large language model technology and agentic AI capabilities
Analyze data and language processing needs and recommend innovative solutions that solve mission-critical problems
Prototype AI/GenAI systems or components based on analysis of workflow and operational mission needs and deliver prototype solutions into operational spaces/systems using real mission-relevant data
Evaluate technology solutions in the context of mission data and workflow needs, and provide actionable recommendations towards workable solutions for critical problems
Convey complex ideas to non-technical audiences through briefings and/or white papers
Lead or contribute to small technical teams to solve technical challenges by applying GenAI capabilities
Leverage MITRE’s Federal AI Sandbox (NVIDIA DGX SuperPod hardware) and AI Platform to support research, development and evaluation of generative AI capabilities

Basic Qualifications:

Requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, computational linguistics, or related disciplines; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Demonstrated recent experience with large language model (LLM) technology applications in R&D or operational settings
Demonstrated experience in prototyping/developing AI components/systems that align with department capabilities (as described above)
Ability to apply state-of-the-art machine learning techniques to data and natural language processing challenges
Experience with programming languages such as Java or Python
Ability to work independently to learn new technologies, methods, processes, frameworks/platforms, and systems
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate challenging technical concepts to both lay and expert audiences
Ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a DOD Secret clearance within 12 months from the date of hire
Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance
This position requires a minimum of 50% hybrid on-site

Preferred Qualifications:

Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, computational linguistics, or related disciplines
Track-record of successful deployment of agentic, generative, and HLT systems or components that have been used by customers or stakeholders outside of a lab/experimental setting
Experience leading small to medium sized teams to solve practical technical challenges
Active DOD security clearance

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

None

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Secret

Salary compensation range and midpoint:

$143,600 - $179,500 - $215,400 Annual

Work Location Type:

Hybrid

Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model - a proprietary AI-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass-box architecture, it uses market data - not personal data - with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. While Fetcherr initially focused on the airline industry, the company is now expanding into additional verticals, bringing its dynamic AI-driven optimization capabilities to new industries such as travel, mobility, retail, e-commerce, and beyond.

About The Role

This is not a pure research role but one that is actively involved in building our product. You will be joining a team of Data Science Engineers and you will be directly contributing to code. You will own well- scoped modeling problems end to end, from exploring market data and designing features to validating models and getting them running in production, so that our pricing, inventory, and network optimization engines make better decisions in real time. This is a high-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of applied AI and production software, working directly with other data scientists, ML and data engineers, and product teams. ﻿

What you will do:

﻿Develop, validate, and iterate on demand forecasting, pricing, and optimization models using large-scale, high-velocity market data.
Explore and analyze data from diverse internal and external sources to uncover signals, define features, and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy and business impact.
Design and run offline experiments, backtests, and online evaluations to measure model performance and profit uplift.
Write production-grade Python code and work with ML and data engineers to productionize models, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.
Monitor deployed models for drift, accuracy, and data quality issues, and troubleshoot and fix problems quickly.
Keep our glass-box principles front and center: build models whose logic and outcomes can be explained to commercial teams and customers.
Partner with product and commercial stakeholders to translate business problems into clear modeling approaches and communicate results.
Contribute to the technical direction of the modeling stack as Fetcherr scales across new customers, verticals, and product lines.

Requirements:

5+ years of full-time experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role building models that run in production. Lab, proof of concept, prototype, academic, and part-time experience does not count toward this requirement.
Strong programming skills in Python, with production-grade coding practices (testing, code review, version control).
Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and time-series forecasting, with sound judgment on model validation and experiment design.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational and non-relational datasets.
Experience and comfort with AI-assisted software development, along with the ability to write and reason about code yourself.
Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and BigQuery preferred) and modern data warehouse and lakehouse technologies.
Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster) and CI/CD practices for ML and data pipelines.
Strong analytical mindset and a pragmatic, get-it-done approach.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and product teams.

Nice to Have

Experience with dynamic pricing, revenue management, or optimization problems.
Experience in travel, e-commerce, logistics, or other real-time decisioning domains.
Exposure to MLOps practices such as model registries, monitoring, and automated retraining.
Experience with real-time OLAP engines such as ClickHouse.
Experience in a Software-as-a-Service environment.

added.title: Senior AI Transformation Engineer
added.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.  
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the role Roku is seeking a Senior AI Transformation Engineer to join the AI Enablement Team and drive end-to-end delivery of agentic AI systems that measurably transform how work gets done across Roku. In this role, you will embed directly with business and technical teams — including Legal, FP&A, Accounting, Brand, Customer Support, and Engineering — to discover the highest-value opportunities for AI-powered automation and deliver production-grade solutions. You will own the full lifecycle from opportunity identification and scoping through system design, build, deployment, and adoption, operating as a self-directed contributor who thrives in ambiguity and can navigate complex organizational dynamics. This is a hands-on builder role that requires strong software engineering fundamentals, deep AI expertise, and a product-oriented mindset focused on adoption and measurable business impact, not demos. You will go beyond point solutions to reimagine how entire functions operate as AI-native, agent-powered systems, and you will codify reusable patterns back into Roku's broader AI platform strategy. The ideal candidate brings technical depth, cross-functional collaboration skills, and the ability to drive change management that ensures the solutions you build are trusted and actively used. 
For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $242,200 - $486,000. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don't just use AI; we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.
We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role? Drive AI deployments from discovery and scoping through system design, build, and production rollout, owning the outcome end to end
Embed directly with business and technical teams to diagnose real problems, often before they are clearly articulated, and identify the highest-value opportunities for agentic automation
Prepare clear scopes of work and pragmatic project plans for both prototypes and full production deployments, making real-time trade-offs on scope, priority, and quality
Design, build, test, and deploy production-grade agentic AI applications and integrations, moving from prototype to live system in short cycles
Reimagine how entire functions operate as AI-native, agent-powered systems, going beyond individual task automation
Connect solutions to Roku's data platforms, internal systems, and enterprise APIs, working across complex and disparate data sources, pipelines, and metric layers
Lead onboarding, enablement, and change management for the teams you serve, iterating on real user feedback until solutions are trusted and actively used
Define and track success through production adoption, workflow impact, and measurable business value
Collaborate with embedded AI Ambassadors, mentor teammates, and flex across functions, domains, and initiatives as priorities evolve
Codify reusable patterns and field learnings back into Roku's broader AI platform strategy to strengthen shared capabilities and frameworks

  We're Excited If You Have 5+ years of software engineering, full-stack engineering, or technical deployment experience with a track record of shipping production systems
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Strong software engineering fundamentals with the ability to write and ship production-grade code (e.g., Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript)
Hands-on experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, generative models, or agentic frameworks
Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity, decomposing open-ended problems into workstreams and making sound trade-offs under pressure
Proven experience working directly with non-technical teams and stakeholders, translating business needs into technical solutions and communicating clearly to executive audiences
A track record of building solutions that achieve adoption and measurable impact
Strong product sense and a bias toward outcomes over output
High autonomy and ownership with the ability to drive decisions and deliver independently in fast-moving environments
Experience with modern AI engineering patterns such as RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool-use, human-in-the-loop controls, model evaluation, and MLOps/LLMOps
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD practices
Experience with modern data architectures and relational databases

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 
To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

added.description:
Machine Learning Engineers
at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy.

This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities.

As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: ML Research Engineering
, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and ML Performance Engineering
, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members.

Your Core Responsibilities

The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.

ML Research Engineering

Develop large-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models.
Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining.
Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost.

ML Performance Engineering

Build and optimise low-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real-time predictions in production systems.
Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries.

Across both areas

Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads.
Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high-volume trading data and delivering real-time, high-accuracy predictions.
Evaluate and roll out third-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities.

Your Skills And Experience

Core, regardless of focus area:

3+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems.
Production software engineering — Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship.
Machine learning fundamentals — you understand modern ML workloads beyond high-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise.
A systems mindset — you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build-versus-buy decisions.
Strong collaboration — comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it.

Depth In One Or More Of The Following

Distributed training and large-scale systems — parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX.
GPU performance and low-level optimisation — reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent).
Production inference systems — hands-on experience building and hardening real-time, low-latency prediction pipelines in high-performance environments.
Numerics and correctness at scale — low-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit-exact.

Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.

Also a Plus

Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools.
A track record of contributing to open-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems.

Not sure this is the one?
If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles.

The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits - US | IMC Trading for more comprehensive information.

Salary Range

$175,000 - $250,000 USD

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

About Emergence AI

Emergence AI is a frontier agentic AI lab advancing safe, autonomous AI through its pioneering neuroformal architecture. We are building the next generation of enterprise AI: systems capable of understanding complex knowledge, reasoning across information, executing multi-step workflows, and taking action with the verifiability and reliability required for mission-critical environments.

Our Enterprise Agent Platform provides the foundation for building, deploying, and operating AI systems in production — from data connectivity and knowledge management to workflow orchestration, observability, evaluation, and governance. We partner with organizations in semiconductor manufacturing, life sciences, and other data-intensive industries to solve complex challenges that require trusted AI systems capable of operating in real-world environments.

Our team brings experience from leading AI research labs and technology companies, including IBM Research, The Allen Institute for AI, Amazon, and Broadcom. With headquarters in New York and offices across California, Spain, and India, we bring together diverse expertise and perspectives to tackle some of the most challenging problems in enterprise AI.

About The Role

As an AI Engineer, you'll build customer-facing capabilities across Emergence's Enterprise Agent Platform, working directly with Product Management, Customer Success, and enterprise customers to turn complex business problems into production-grade AI systems. You'll operate as an AI-native engineer, using AI development tools to accelerate delivery while owning architecture, engineering quality, and customer outcomes. We care more about engineering judgment, ownership, and the ability to learn than expertise in any specific language or framework.

You'll

Build the core Enterprise Agent Platform that lets customers create, configure, deploy, and operate AI agents securely at scale, including agent orchestration, workflow execution, context management, memory, governance, and enterprise integrations.
Partner with customers in semiconductor manufacturing, life sciences, and other data-intensive industries to build production-ready AI workflows, then turn those customer-specific solutions into reusable platform capabilities that benefit every customer.
Design the systems that make enterprise AI trustworthy, including evaluation frameworks, verification pipelines, policy enforcement, audit trails, observability, provenance, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Build the data and knowledge capabilities that connect to enterprise data sources, discover schemas and semantic relationships, and give AI agents the context needed to reason accurately over complex business data.

Work directly with Product Management, Customer Success, and enterprise customers in workshops, technical discussions, and production deployments to rapidly understand problems and ship solutions.
Own features from concept through production, making thoughtful engineering decisions around APIs, architecture, scalability, security, and performance.
Raise the engineering bar by establishing reusable patterns and best practices, evaluating emerging AI tools for what meaningfully improves engineering productivity, and continuously simplifying how we build.

You'll Have

3+ years of professional software engineering experience building production software.
AI-native engineer who uses Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar AI development tools as part of your daily engineering workflow, not just a tool you occasionally reach for.
Strong software engineering fundamentals — production backend services, APIs, distributed systems, cloud applications, or developer platforms — and comfortable working across the stack, picking up new languages and frameworks quickly.
Experience building and shipping software used by real customers in production environments.
Strong problem-solving skills, sound engineering judgment, and excellent communication with customers, product managers, designers, and engineers.
Self-driven, curious, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.

Bonus Points

Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, or enterprise AI applications.
Experience with LLMs, tool calling, RAG, context engineering, memory systems, or multi-agent orchestration.
Experience integrating enterprise data sources such as databases, data warehouses, SaaS applications, APIs, or document repositories.

Experience with cloud-native platforms, Kubernetes, observability, distributed tracing, or production operations.
Demonstrated curiosity, rapid learning, and a passion for solving difficult engineering problems.

Flexible hybrid/remote work environment.

The opportunity to work at the forefront of technological advancement.

Key Responsibilities

Develop algorithms that extract meaning from complex technical documents containing text, vector geometry, CAD, and raster content, spanning vision models, geometric algorithms, and language understanding.
Build document-understanding capabilities into the tools that power long-running agentic systems.
Improve the reliability, determinism, and effectiveness of agentic systems, including agent planning, tool usage, and failure recovery.
Build and extend training and evaluation pipelines for core models and agents, ensuring every change is measured against real customer data before deployment.
Analyze algorithm performance in production, identify failure patterns, and develop targeted improvements.
Identify gaps and bias in datasets and address them through data curation, labeling, or synthetic data generation.
Monitor emerging research and techniques and adapt promising approaches for production use.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team.

Examples of Work You Could Own

Fix a Failure Class: Investigate why extraction fails on specific types of technical drawings, such as dense electrical schematics, and improve performance through better data, models, or algorithms.
Fine-Tune a Specialized Model: Fine-tune a LoRA on an in-house model to extract specialized artifacts from high-resolution blueprint pages.
Bring a New Algorithm to Production: Evaluate approaches from recent research, such as layout or table-structure models, demonstrate improvements against existing solutions, and make them reliable and efficient enough for production.
Improve Retrieval: Enhance retrieval quality, relevance, and latency across different document types and customers.
Make Agents More Deterministic: Investigate why the same task produces inconsistent results across multiple runs and improve the tools or agent loop to deliver consistent outcomes.

Experience

We're looking for someone who has successfully shipped ML-powered software into production, can adapt proven approaches, evaluate alternatives, and measure the impact of improvements on customers.

Ideally, you'll have deep expertise and strong technical opinions in at least one of the following areas:

Agent harness design and execution.
Document extraction and structured data understanding.
High-resolution computer vision.
Vision-language model (VLM) fine-tuning and inference.
Retrieval systems, including embeddings and reranking.
Agent evaluation and optimization.

You don't need to be an expert in every area. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to lead technical decisions are more important than familiarity with any specific technology stack.

Required Qualifications

Hands-on AI/ML engineering experience with a proven track record of shipping models into production.
Experience training and fine-tuning production models, including building the datasets and pipelines behind them.
Experience developing and operating ML evaluation pipelines, including datasets, metrics, and regression testing for production models and agents.
Experience analyzing data distributions, identifying gaps and bias, and curating high-quality training and evaluation datasets.
Experience with vision and multimodal models, particularly technical documents such as PDFs and CAD files containing text, vector geometry, and raster content.
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
Proven expertise in LLMs, deep learning systems, and applied machine learning.
Experience debugging production ML systems using AI observability tools such as Langfuse, Opik, or similar platforms.
Proficiency in Python and relevant ML frameworks such as PyTorch and vLLM.
Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools, including effective prompting, iterative refinement, and the ability to identify incorrect or unreliable AI-generated code.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of computational geometry or experience with vector drawing formats such as CAD and vector PDFs.
Experience with Go programming language.
Familiarity with construction, civil engineering, manufacturing, or related industries where interpreting complex technical drawings and specifications is essential.

Human Skills

Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering reliable, production-ready systems.
Strong product judgment and understanding of how system behavior impacts user experience and trust.
Ability to rigorously review agent instructions, skills, and documentation to ensure clarity, accuracy, and reliability.
Curiosity about how systems behave in practice and how customers interact with them.
Bias toward execution and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into working solutions.
Strong judgment about production readiness and the willingness to challenge decisions that are not grounded in customer outcomes.
Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain ML tradeoffs to engineers, FDEs, and product stakeholders.
Critical evaluation of AI-generated output, including identifying hallucinated APIs, incorrect logic, and subtle bugs.
Systems-thinking mindset, with attention to correctness, determinism, and failure modes in long-running agents.

Arcesium is building a Corporate AI Transformation team, and you will be one of its few first members. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work closely with business, operations and engineering teams to identify high-impact internal use cases and convert them into working AI solutions that run in production.

This is not a traditional backend or application engineering role. You will operate like a builder, systems engineer, and product thinker rolled into one. You will take ambiguous business problems, break them into solvable workflows, design the agent architecture, and ship production-grade internal tools. You will work with Arcesium's corporate systems, data assets, and AI tech stack to build agents and automations that reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, and scale repeatable work. Success for this role isn’t just measured by shipping a prototype or completing a project, it’s measured by putting solutions into production and driving meaningful adoption and impact.

The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, a builder’s mindset, and a passion for using AI to improve how work gets done. This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to build AI solutions that meaningfully improve enterprise processes.

Responsibilities

Partner with business and functional teams to find the opportunities: workflow automation, AI-assisted decision-making, and work that agents can take on.
Understand complex operational processes across teams and convert them into structured problem statements, system designs, and technical workflows.
Build agents, workflow automations, and internal applications on top of Arcesium's corporate data systems, and enterprise tools.
Rapidly prototype using LLMs, agent frameworks, MCPs. Get something small in front of real users early and iterate on their feedback.
Design agent architectures that complete business tasks reliably.
Work with engineering, business, and security teams to take prototypes to move prototypes into scalable, maintainable solutions.
Evaluate build-vs-buy options for AI workflows and identify the right technical approach for each use case.
Create reusable components, templates and playbooks that accelerate this work across the firm.
Define the KPIs, measure the impact, and drive adoption.

Qualifications

6+ years of hands-on engineering experience, with a track record of shipping systems that other people depend on.
Strong engineering fundamentals across APIs, data, and systems design.
Experience building internal tools or automation systems for business teams.
The ability to understand a platform quickly, build on top of it, and turn business context into reliable technical solutions.
Systems thinking. You can hold a whole workflow in your head, see where it is structurally inefficient, and redesign it rather than automate it as it stands.
A bias to ship iteratively. You get a thin version into real use, learn from it, and improve it, instead of waiting for a complete design.
Credibility with senior business and technology leaders, and the ability to say hard things clearly to both.
Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You will pick your own problems as often as you are handed them.

For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

Your Role

We are seeking an AWS Technical Architect with a strong integration background to design and deliver cloud solutions that connect our clinical, operational, and commercial systems. You will work within an established architecture team, contributing to solution design and hands-on delivery while growing toward senior architectural leadership.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, enterprise integration, and healthcare technology — helping Vantive modernize how we connect systems that ultimately support patient care.

Design and implement AWS-based architectures for integration workloads connecting clinical, supply chain, and enterprise systems
Develop integration patterns including API design, event-driven messaging, and data synchronization across Vantive's application landscape
Contribute to architectural standards, design patterns, and technical documentation

Evaluate and recommend appropriate AWS services for specific use cases
Support delivery teams with technical guidance, design reviews, and troubleshooting
Participate in solution design for hybrid integration scenarios (cloud-to-on-premise, SaaS-to-platform)
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and CI/CD pipeline design
Ensure solutions meet healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements (HIPAA, GxP where applicable)

What You’ll Bring

Cloud Architecture

3+ years of hands-on experience building solutions on AWS
Solid knowledge of core AWS services: Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, or CloudFormation)
Understanding of AWS Well-Architected Framework principles
Working knowledge of networking concepts (VPC, security groups, PrivateLink)
Experience with monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray)

Integration

Demonstrated experience designing and implementing integration solutions
Strong understanding of API-first design, RESTful APIs, and asynchronous messaging patterns
Familiarity with integration patterns: event sourcing, pub/sub, saga, request-reply
Experience integrating enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, clinical systems, or supply chain platforms)
Knowledge of data transformation, mapping, and protocol mediation
Experience with middleware, iPaaS, or integration platforms

General

Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Ability to produce clear technical documentation and architecture diagrams
Comfortable working in agile delivery teams
Awareness of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) is a plus

AI & Machine Learning

Awareness of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to enterprise workflows
Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML services (any provider) such as natural language processing, document extraction, or predictive analytics
Interest in or exposure to generative AI, large language models, or AI-assisted automation
Understanding of how AI capabilities can be integrated into existing application architectures
Awareness of responsible AI principles and data governance considerations

Agentic AI

Familiarity with agentic AI patterns — autonomous agents that plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks with minimal human intervention
Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar)
Understanding of tool-use patterns where AI agents invoke APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows autonomously
Awareness of multi-agent architectures — coordinating specialized agents for complex business processes
Interest in applying agentic AI to enterprise use cases such as intelligent document processing, automated decision support, or self-healing integrations
Understanding of human-in-the-loop patterns, guardrails, and safety mechanisms for autonomous AI systems
Awareness of memory and context management strategies for long-running agent interactions

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
5–8+ years total experience in software engineering or architecture roles
AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification (Professional certification is a plus)
Good communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences

Nice to Have

Experience in healthcare, medical devices, or regulated industries
Familiarity with HIPAA, GxP, or FDA software validation requirements
Knowledge of containerization (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
Experience with data platforms or analytics pipelines
TOGAF or similar enterprise architecture framework exposure
Experience working in global or multi-region environments

Vantive is committed to supporting the need for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a minimum of 3 days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in-person in support of our Mission.

Collaborates with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and ensure AI solutions align with organizational KPIs and decision-making needs.
Documents AI system architectures, integration patterns, and deployment strategies to support knowledge sharing and organizational learning.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in traditional AI methodologies including deep learning, supervised and unsupervised learning, and NLP techniques (e.g., tokenization, named entity recognition, text classification, sentiment analysis).
Production experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines, and vector database integration.
Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks: Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, and AutoGen.
Strong proficiency in Python with deep experience in Pandas, PySpark, TensorFlow, and XGBoost; experience building production-grade applications required.
Extensive experience designing, developing, and deploying RESTful APIs and microservices.
Experience with cloud ML platforms (GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML) and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS).
Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes) and/or full-stack development experience (React, Golang).
Knowledge of prompt tuning, fine-tuning, and parameter-efficient adaptation methods (LoRA, PEFT).
Familiarity with knowledge graph construction and integration with LLM and multi-agent systems.
Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to present complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

added.description:
Overview

With over 50 years of proven success, ECG, ranked as a Best Midsized Firm to Work For 2026 by Consulting Magazine , is the most experienced healthcare consulting firm in the US. Working exclusively in this space, our people consistently demonstrate their ability to solve challenges for providers and achieve better patient outcomes. Across our seven office locations, we’re seeking individuals who will show the courage to find innovative solutions and make a direct impact on the delivery of healthcare services nationwide.

About ECG

ECG is a national consulting firm that is redefining healthcare together with its clients. We provide a broad range of strategic, financial, operational, and technology-enabled consulting services to the full continuum of care, including hospitals, health systems, medical groups, academic medical centers, children’s hospitals, cancer centers, ambulatory surgery centers, investors, and payers/health plans.

Our work focuses on creating practical, tailored solutions that help clients maximize resources and achieve sustainable results. We value collaboration, integrity, and innovation, and are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Job Details

Join Our Analytics Hub

Our growing Analytics Hub works with our consulting teams to deliver new insights, streamlined analysis, and world-class intelligence to the healthcare organizations we serve as clients. Combined with our consulting teams, you will be helping physician and executive leadership make informed decisions that can alter the course of their enterprises in areas such as physician alignment, mergers and acquisitions, service line planning, provider compensation, financial performance, transforming care models, patient access, managed care portfolio optimization, digital health expansion, and more. ECG uses a Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment, with Microsoft Power BI as ECG’s current analytics visualization platform.

Our detailed plans incorporate qualitative findings with data-driven strategic, operational, and financial considerations that enable organizations to pursue realistic change. Our consultants bridge the gap between strategic thinking and operational implementation with sensible action plans and tactical recommendations. This approach allows us to stretch our clients’ thinking while ensuring that initiatives with the broadest and deepest impact are prioritized and implementable. Our wide-ranging engagements often focus on helping our clients:

Position themselves for value-based care delivery.
Align hospitals and physician organizations.
Strengthen financial performance.
Enhance clinical programs.
Develop strategic partnerships and/or mergers.

Your Opportunity with ECG: Senior Healthcare AI Engineer

As a senior healthcare AI engineer, you will help drive the firm's AI strategy by designing, developing, and deploying intelligent solutions that enhance client delivery, accelerate internal operations, and create new service offerings. Working closely with consultants, healthcare subject matter experts, data engineers, and business leaders, you will transform complex healthcare and business challenges into scalable AI-powered applications.

In addition, you will partner with internal teams including IT, learning and development, business development, and analytics engineering to establish AI best practices, evaluate emerging technologies, and build secure, governed, and scalable AI capabilities across the organization. Here, no two days or projects are alike, which means you’ll have a lot to learn and plenty of support to help you succeed.

We are seeking an innovative and technically skilled senior healthcare AI engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI solutions that improve healthcare operations, clinical decision-making, and business performance. This individual will work at the intersection of healthcare, data science, software engineering, and generative AI, developing scalable solutions that utilize healthcare data to create actionable insights and automate complex workflows.

Your Responsibilities May Include

AI and Machine Learning (ML) Development

Design and develop production-grade generative AI, ML, and agentic AI solutions for healthcare and business applications.
Collaborate with IT and Hub members to deploy solutions.
Build retrieval-augmented generation systems, intelligent assistants, AI agents, and workflow automation solutions using enterprise and healthcare data.
Develop evaluation frameworks that measure solution quality, accuracy, groundedness, reliability, and business impact.
Contribute to the creation and improvement of automated testing methodologies, benchmark datasets, and regression testing processes to ensure AI solutions remain stable as prompts, models, and data sources evolve.
Partner with business stakeholders (consultants, clients, business development, HR, etc.) to define success metrics and acceptance criteria for AI-powered applications.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend architectures that balance performance, cost, scalability, and risk.

AI Solution Architecture

Deploy and operationalize AI solutions within secure enterprise and client environments.
Design scalable architectures that support customer-facing AI applications, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation solutions.
Build and maintain CI/CD processes, monitoring capabilities, and deployment pipelines for AI applications.
Implement observability, telemetry, and performance monitoring to track quality, adoption, and operational health.
Collaborate with IT, cybersecurity, and governance teams to ensure secure deployment and compliance with firm requirements.

Governance, Security, and Compliance

Ensure AI systems comply with HIPAA, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC2, HITRUST), where applicable.
Contribute to AI governance practices around model monitoring, fairness, transparency, explainability, and risk mitigation.
Collaborate with cybersecurity and data governance teams to ensure secure deployment of AI solutions.

Collaboration and Innovation

Partner with division leaders, healthcare consultants, clinicians, and operational stakeholders to identify AI opportunities.
Translate business requirements into technical AI solutions.
Present findings, recommendations, and system capabilities to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, healthcare innovation, and industry best practices.

Qualifications

Strong knowledge of and passion for the healthcare industry
Bachelor’s degree in either computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, statistics, health information management, or a related degree that relies heavily on critical thinking, logic, and math
A master's degree is a plus

5+ years of professional experience working in data engineering or data science
Healthcare or consulting experience is preferred

2+ years of recent experience developing production AI, ML, or advanced analytics solutions
Strong proficiency in:
Python, SQL, and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn)
Microsoft Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS, or Google Cloud AI; strong preference for Azure AI Services

Experience developing and deploying LLM-based applications
Experience with agentic AI frameworks and LLM evaluation frameworks
Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and cloud architecture
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Preferred

Work with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, DICOM, ICD-10, CPT, and revenue cycle data
Experience working with healthcare data, healthcare technology, healthcare consulting, health systems, payer organizations, or digital health companies
Experience deploying agents from Azure AI Foundry and/or Microsoft Copilot Studio
Experience using the Microsoft Fabric platform

Job Locations

Preferred locations: Chicago or Washington, D.C.
Other locations: Boston
We will consider remote hires, but prefer an in-office presence through our hybrid model

Schedule

Full time/exempt

What You Can Expect Of Us

To reward our driven, innovative, and passionate employees, we’ve built a company culture that’s centered on performance. We offer an attractive compensation package, challenging work, and an entrepreneurial environment where you can take ownership of your career—and get out as much as you put in.

The estimated base salary range for this job is $170000.00 - $190000.00 annually. It represents a good faith estimate of the range that ECG reasonably expects to pay at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to years of experience, special skills, and market changes. This job is eligible to participate in ECG’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects ECG’s pay-for-performance philosophy. The job is also eligible to participate in ECG’s benefit plans, which include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) matching program, unlimited PTO, and other wellness programs.
