With over 50 years of proven success, ECG, ranked as a Best Midsized Firm to Work For 2026 by Consulting Magazine , is the most experienced healthcare consulting firm in the US. Working exclusively in this space, our people consistently demonstrate their ability to solve challenges for providers and achieve better patient outcomes. Across our seven office locations, we’re seeking individuals who will show the courage to find innovative solutions and make a direct impact on the delivery of healthcare services nationwide.

About ECG

ECG is a national consulting firm that is redefining healthcare together with its clients. We provide a broad range of strategic, financial, operational, and technology-enabled consulting services to the full continuum of care, including hospitals, health systems, medical groups, academic medical centers, children’s hospitals, cancer centers, ambulatory surgery centers, investors, and payers/health plans.

Our work focuses on creating practical, tailored solutions that help clients maximize resources and achieve sustainable results. We value collaboration, integrity, and innovation, and are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Job Details

Join Our Analytics Hub

Our growing Analytics Hub works with our consulting teams to deliver new insights, streamlined analysis, and world-class intelligence to the healthcare organizations we serve as clients. Combined with our consulting teams, you will be helping physician and executive leadership make informed decisions that can alter the course of their enterprises in areas such as physician alignment, mergers and acquisitions, service line planning, provider compensation, financial performance, transforming care models, patient access, managed care portfolio optimization, digital health expansion, and more. ECG uses a Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment, with Microsoft Power BI as ECG’s current analytics visualization platform.

Our detailed plans incorporate qualitative findings with data-driven strategic, operational, and financial considerations that enable organizations to pursue realistic change. Our consultants bridge the gap between strategic thinking and operational implementation with sensible action plans and tactical recommendations. This approach allows us to stretch our clients’ thinking while ensuring that initiatives with the broadest and deepest impact are prioritized and implementable. Our wide-ranging engagements often focus on helping our clients:

Position themselves for value-based care delivery.
Align hospitals and physician organizations.
Strengthen financial performance.
Enhance clinical programs.
Develop strategic partnerships and/or mergers.

Your Opportunity with ECG: Senior Healthcare AI Engineer

As a senior healthcare AI engineer, you will help drive the firm's AI strategy by designing, developing, and deploying intelligent solutions that enhance client delivery, accelerate internal operations, and create new service offerings. Working closely with consultants, healthcare subject matter experts, data engineers, and business leaders, you will transform complex healthcare and business challenges into scalable AI-powered applications.

In addition, you will partner with internal teams including IT, learning and development, business development, and analytics engineering to establish AI best practices, evaluate emerging technologies, and build secure, governed, and scalable AI capabilities across the organization. Here, no two days or projects are alike, which means you’ll have a lot to learn and plenty of support to help you succeed.

We are seeking an innovative and technically skilled senior healthcare AI engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI solutions that improve healthcare operations, clinical decision-making, and business performance. This individual will work at the intersection of healthcare, data science, software engineering, and generative AI, developing scalable solutions that utilize healthcare data to create actionable insights and automate complex workflows.

Your Responsibilities May Include

AI and Machine Learning (ML) Development

Design and develop production-grade generative AI, ML, and agentic AI solutions for healthcare and business applications.
Collaborate with IT and Hub members to deploy solutions.
Build retrieval-augmented generation systems, intelligent assistants, AI agents, and workflow automation solutions using enterprise and healthcare data.
Develop evaluation frameworks that measure solution quality, accuracy, groundedness, reliability, and business impact.
Contribute to the creation and improvement of automated testing methodologies, benchmark datasets, and regression testing processes to ensure AI solutions remain stable as prompts, models, and data sources evolve.
Partner with business stakeholders (consultants, clients, business development, HR, etc.) to define success metrics and acceptance criteria for AI-powered applications.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend architectures that balance performance, cost, scalability, and risk.

AI Solution Architecture

Deploy and operationalize AI solutions within secure enterprise and client environments.
Design scalable architectures that support customer-facing AI applications, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation solutions.
Build and maintain CI/CD processes, monitoring capabilities, and deployment pipelines for AI applications.
Implement observability, telemetry, and performance monitoring to track quality, adoption, and operational health.
Collaborate with IT, cybersecurity, and governance teams to ensure secure deployment and compliance with firm requirements.

Governance, Security, and Compliance

Ensure AI systems comply with HIPAA, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC2, HITRUST), where applicable.
Contribute to AI governance practices around model monitoring, fairness, transparency, explainability, and risk mitigation.
Collaborate with cybersecurity and data governance teams to ensure secure deployment of AI solutions.

Collaboration and Innovation

Partner with division leaders, healthcare consultants, clinicians, and operational stakeholders to identify AI opportunities.
Translate business requirements into technical AI solutions.
Present findings, recommendations, and system capabilities to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, healthcare innovation, and industry best practices.

Qualifications

Strong knowledge of and passion for the healthcare industry
Bachelor’s degree in either computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, statistics, health information management, or a related degree that relies heavily on critical thinking, logic, and math
A master's degree is a plus

5+ years of professional experience working in data engineering or data science
Healthcare or consulting experience is preferred

2+ years of recent experience developing production AI, ML, or advanced analytics solutions
Strong proficiency in:
Python, SQL, and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn)
Microsoft Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS, or Google Cloud AI; strong preference for Azure AI Services

Experience developing and deploying LLM-based applications
Experience with agentic AI frameworks and LLM evaluation frameworks
Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and cloud architecture
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Preferred

Work with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, DICOM, ICD-10, CPT, and revenue cycle data
Experience working with healthcare data, healthcare technology, healthcare consulting, health systems, payer organizations, or digital health companies
Experience deploying agents from Azure AI Foundry and/or Microsoft Copilot Studio
Experience using the Microsoft Fabric platform

Job Locations

Preferred locations: Chicago or Washington, D.C.
Other locations: Boston
We will consider remote hires, but prefer an in-office presence through our hybrid model

Schedule

Full time/exempt

What You Can Expect Of Us

To reward our driven, innovative, and passionate employees, we’ve built a company culture that’s centered on performance. We offer an attractive compensation package, challenging work, and an entrepreneurial environment where you can take ownership of your career—and get out as much as you put in.

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. Come join a #1 team and do some good!

HYBRID:
Hybrid Work Arrangement: A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. Bloomington, IL; Dunwoody, GA; Richardson, TX; or Tempe, AZ

Responsibilities

Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential

We are looking for a skilled Lead Software Engineer with strong expertise in Python backend development and AI/LLM integration. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the LARRY FastAPI backend, including LLM-powered conversation flows, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and knowledge ingestion APIs. You will collaborate with architects, product owners, and SMEs to shape a platform that processes interviews, documents, and mainframe artifacts into structured, queryable knowledge objects.

Design, develop, and maintain the LARRY FastAPI backend, including REST API endpoints for conversation, ingestion, and knowledge retrieval
Build and support LLM-powered RAG pipelines that query the kcd-repository knowledge base and surface relevant answers
Lead backend architecture decisions and mentor junior engineers on the team
Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and architects to ensure accurate knowledge processing and retrieval
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines via GitLab CI/CD for deployment to ROSA (OpenShift)
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing to maintain high-quality, secure code
Integrate with Entra ID (Azure AD) for authentication and manage secure API access patterns
Research and adopt emerging LLM and RAG patterns to improve knowledge quality and retrieval accuracy

Qualifications

Strong Python or React experience, including FastAPI or similar async web frameworks
Experience with LLM integration and RAG architecture patterns
Experience designing, developing, and maintaining RESTful APIs
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployment
Solid understanding of Git and version control workflows
Experience with AWS or other cloud environments

Preferred Qualifications

Process and transform mainframe artifacts (JCL, DB2 , COBOL) into structured, schema-compliant knowledge objects
Experience with vector databases or embedding-based
Experience with JSON schema design and knowledge graph or structured data patterns
Integrate with Entra ID (Azure AD) for authentication and manage secure API access patterns

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

added.title: Applied Scientist II, Prime Video - Ads Science
added.description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Key job responsibilities

The Science Challenges Include

Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time.
Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals.
Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles.
Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies.
Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric.

A day in the life

Contribute to the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind
Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale
Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization
Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements
Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions
Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions

About The Team

Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of building models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C++

added.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Applied AI & Data Architecture
added.description:
Description

Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026

Do you want to define how enterprises customize their own models ? Do you enjoy work that spans data curation, post-training, evaluation, and production deployment of customized models?

As a Senior Applied Scientist in Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will build that path from customization to trusted evaluation. You will prove it with customers on their own data. You will help customers decide when and how to customize foundation models, using techniques that range from parameter-efficient fine-tuning and distillation to preference optimization and reinforcement fine-tuning. You will turn that work into reusable recipes, evaluation methods, and open-source accelerators that let builders customize models reliably and cost-effectively.

The role splits roughly 50/50 between direct customer engagements and building leverage through reusable science assets, open source, and thought leadership.

Customer work: You will partner with customer science and engineering teams on their hardest customization problems. You'll frame the problem, choose the right approach, design the evaluation, and work hands-on to get customized models into production.
Building time : You will develop reference implementations and training recipes, contribute to open-source projects, and publish findings that raise the bar for the broader community. You will work closely with AWS service teams to close the loop between what customers need and what AWS builds.

You will be the team's scientific bar-raiser. You will set evaluation standards, review modeling choices, and publish what you learn, internally and externally. You will work closely with the service teams so that the patterns we prove in the field become native features.

This is a global role within the Solutions Architect organization. You will maintain deep relationships with AI service and science teams and collaborate with specialists and builder customers across regions to stay current on the state of the art and influence roadmaps.

Key job responsibilities

Own the evaluation methodology. Design the evaluation methodology behind every model-selection and customization decision. Score quality, cost, latency, and safety in a way that is reproducible, statistically sound, and calibrated to each customer's quality bar.
Lead customization engagements end to end. Drive work from data curation and synthetic data generation through fine-tuning, distillation, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning. Re-score every change against the same harness so customers see exactly what they gained.
Invent where no textbook solution exists. Develop new techniques such as reward design for agentic tasks, simulation-based evaluation, and efficient serving of small decision models, then package them as reusable code any Solutions Architect can run.
Turn engagement learnings into reusable assets. Build reference architectures, open-source accelerators, workshops, enablement materials, blogs, and papers that form a repeatable path from evaluation through deployment.
Advise field teams and customers. Act as the scientific advisor on trade-offs among prompting, retrieval, customization, and frontier models, including knowing when not to customize.
Mentor and influence across teams. Mentor engineers and Solutions Architects in ML methodology. Turn customer evidence into feature requests and proposals for AWS service teams that make field-proven patterns native product capabilities.

A day in the life

You start the morning reviewing a customer's distillation results, where a smaller model is closing the gap with a much larger one. The gains cluster in one task slice, so you flag possible data leakage before the design review. Afterward, you add a held-out evaluation set and a capability-regression check to the training recipe. In the afternoon, you share engagement findings with a product team to shape how evaluation fits into the customization workflow. You wrap up by refining an open-source evaluation harness you'll release alongside a customer workshop.

About The Team

Applied AI and Data Architects (AIDA) is a team of specialized AI prototypers with a product mindset. The team builds a portfolio of domain-specific Tech Field Products in areas such as semantics, data engineering, ML, AI security/governance/agent-ops, and DevOps. Model customization and evaluation is one of the team's focus areas. Its goal is to make foundation and open weight model customization repeatable, measurable, and accessible to builders. Each product is grounded in customer reality. The team earns the right to guide by building alongside customers.

Basic Qualifications

PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
4+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.
Experience customizing models for agentic use cases, such as tool use, multi-step reasoning, or reinforcement learning from environment or verifier feedback
Experience with model efficiency techniques such as quantization, distillation, and inference cost and latency optimization

added.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
You'll join our Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering experts within the  Applied Technology & AI  team. This team is part of Bain's digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.
THE ROLE
As a Lead, Full-Stack Data Scientist, you will leverage your experience to design, implement and refine algorithms to extract and use actionable information from multi-modal data across a wide range of industries and business problems. Y ou bring a strong generalist foundation across core data science methods (e.g., statistics, forecasting, optimization, and machine learning) that lets you move fluidly across problem types rather than specializing narrowly in one. Y ou’ll develop and deploy analytical and machine learning models that power production systems such as dynamic personalization and pricing engines, predictive maintenance and always-on forecasting and optimization capabilities.

This role will be focused on advancing personalization and recommender systems and search to drive user experience and growth.

Prepare and present ML modeling results and analytical insights that help drive the business to senior leadership.

8 + years of work experience in Machine Learning, AI and Data Science with a proven track record to drive innovation and business impacts

Strong machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling expertise, such as causal inference modeling, ensembles, neural networks, NLP, reinforcement learning and bandits

Are you ready to dive into the world of transformative therapies and make a significant impact? At EsoBiotec, now part of AstraZeneca, we are setting new benchmarks for biotechnological research. Our collaboration combines AstraZeneca’s global influence and scientific innovation with EsoBiotec’s unique culture of creativity and breakthroughs in cell-based therapies and immunology. Here, your scientific passion will drive real-world impact as you contribute to life-changing treatments.

We are seeking a cross-disciplinary AI Engineer
 to support a highly  wet-lab-focused discovery research team
 working at the forefront of  CAR-T
,  in vivo lentiviral delivery
, and  oncology
. This role will help accelerate research by applying  AI, machine learning, and data-centric engineering
 to experimental workflows, biological data, and decision-making across early discovery and platform development.

The position is designed for someone who can work effectively at the interface of  experimental science
 and  computational innovation
. The successful candidate will partner closely with bench scientists to understand biological questions, experimental systems, and data-generation challenges, and then translate those into practical computational approaches that improve insight generation, prioritization, and research efficiency.

As a Cross-Disciplinary AI Engineer
, you will work alongside researchers developing next-generation approaches in  cell therapy
,  gene delivery
, and  oncology discovery
. Much of the team’s work is rooted in screening, vector design, cellular profiling, functional assays, and iterative platform optimization. Your role will be to identify where AI and advanced analytics can have real impact, build fit-for-purpose models and tools, and help create stronger connections between experimental output and computational decision support.

This is not a role focused primarily on medicinal chemistry or small-molecule discovery. Instead, it centers on the biological and translational challenges associated with  engineered cell therapies
,  viral delivery systems
, and the interpretation of complex experimental datasets in oncology-relevant systems.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with experimental scientists working in CAR-T, lentiviral delivery, cell engineering, and oncology discovery to understand key scientific questions, assay workflows, and experimental decision points.
Translate wet-lab problems into AI and data science opportunities, such as construct prioritization, delivery optimization, cell-state characterization, image-based phenotyping, multimodal data integration, or prediction of experimental outcomes.
Build, adapt, and apply AI/ML models to support discovery activities, including predictive models, classification models, clustering approaches, representation learning, computer vision pipelines, or LLM-enabled knowledge workflows where appropriate.
Work across diverse biological datasets, such as flow cytometry, single-cell and bulk omics, imaging, functional assay readouts, vector characterization data, metadata, and experimental annotations.
Develop data pipelines and analytical frameworks that improve data quality, accessibility, interoperability, and reuse across experimental programs.
Create practical tools and visualizations that enable bench scientists to explore data, compare constructs or conditions, and make more informed decisions about what to test next.
Collaborate cross-functionally with biologists, immunologists, gene therapy scientists, bioinformaticians, data scientists, and software/informatics partners.
Evaluate and communicate model performance with attention to biological validity, robustness, interpretability, and limitations in real experimental settings.
Help establish best practices for reproducible, responsible, and scientifically grounded AI use in discovery research.
Monitor emerging methods in AI, computational biology, and multimodal learning, and identify opportunities to apply them meaningfully in CAR-T and in vivo delivery research.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s in computer science, machine learning, computational biology, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, systems biology, applied mathematics, or a related field.
At least 5 years' experience developing AI/ML solutions in biological, biomedical, or R&D environments.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with relevant data science and machine learning frameworks.
Experience working with complex experimental datasets and building practical analyses or tools that support scientific decision-making.
Ability to work effectively with wet-lab researchers and communicate clearly across computational and experimental disciplines.
Experience handling ambiguity and translating open-ended scientific questions into structured computational approaches.
Strong grounding in data quality, model evaluation, reproducibility, and analytical rigor.

Advanced degree preferred (Master’s, or PhD)
Experience in one or more of the following areas: cell therapy, CAR-T, gene therapy, viral vector biology, lentiviral systems, immuno-oncology, or functional genomics.
Familiarity with biological data modalities relevant to this space, including flow cytometry, single-cell RNA-seq, multimodal omics, imaging, perturbation datasets, and high-dimensional assay data.
Experience with multimodal learning, representation learning, scientific image analysis, active learning, Bayesian optimization, LLM-enabled scientific workflows, or knowledge graph approaches.

added.title: Research Engineer
added.description:
Company

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts.

The Role

We’re looking for a Research Engineer to build and improve the systems that turn complex knowledge into formal representations and use them to reason and prove. You’ll work closely with researchers and formal methods engineers on Pramaana’s domain formalizer, autoformalizer, and prover, making these systems more accurate, repeatable, and efficient.

This is a hands-on role combining software engineering with careful experimentation. Your work could include building model and tool orchestration, improving evaluation, developing data pipelines and training environments, or implementing new representations. You’ll own a focused workstream based on your strengths and the team’s needs, with room to contribute across the research stack.

You’ll take ideas from an initial experiment to a tested implementation, investigate failures, and measure whether changes improve correctness, coverage, latency, and cost.

What You'll Do

Build next-generation neuro-symbolic AI systems at the intersection of foundation models, formal methods, automated reasoning, and verification.
Design rigorous evaluation frameworks and research benchmarks to study reasoning capabilities, generalization, robustness, and computational efficiency.
Develop advanced post-training and data synthesis pipelines, exploring techniques in synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning, and model self-improvement.
Research and implement approaches to knowledge representation, compositional reasoning, program synthesis, and constraint-based inference for complex real-world domains.
Drive end-to-end research and engineering, from rapid prototyping and controlled experimentation to ablation studies, performance optimization, and scalable production systems.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have

Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building large-scale ML systems, research infrastructure, or high-performance training pipelines.
Experience training or post-training large foundation models, including distributed training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and large-scale experimentation.
Deep proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks, such as PyTorch, JAX, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, or equivalent distributed training and inference infrastructure.
Experience building agentic AI systems, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration, and evaluation of complex model behaviors.
Familiarity with modern post-training techniques, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference optimization, synthetic data generation, and reasoning-focused training.
Strong research and experimental judgment, with experience designing benchmarks, running ablation studies, analyzing model failures, and translating research ideas into measurable improvements.
Ability to operate independently at the intersection of research and engineering, rapidly prototyping ambitious ideas and scaling successful experiments into robust systems.

Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience building autoformalization, theorem-proving, or other systems that combine models with symbolic tools.
Experience with Lean, Coq, Isabelle, SMT solvers, compilers, or program analysis.
Experience optimizing model inference, parallel workloads, or evaluation pipelines for speed and cost.
Substantial research code, open-source contributions, or projects that demonstrate strong engineering and experimental work.

Prior experience in formal verification is not required. We value strong engineering, careful experimentation, and the curiosity to learn how models and formal systems work together.

Company

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. The role

We're training foundation models to natively interact with symbolic world models. Scale RLVR to new, real-world domains using the Lean kernel as a deterministic reward signal.
Design and implement novel RL algorithms and test-time compute optimizations tailored for formal environments and proof search.
Push the frontier of autoformalization, training models to map highly technical natural language into strict formal specifications.
Curate data and build evals that tightly correlate with verifiable downstream reasoning capabilities.
Own the whole loop: rollout sampling, reward design, the update, the eval.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have

Deep, hands-on research experience in reinforcement learning applied to reasoning models at scale.
Experience working with RLVR, test-time RL, or exact deterministic reward signals.
Strong algorithmic and systems intuition — comfortable writing custom RL loops, managing data pipelines, and building robust evals from scratch.
High autonomy: the ability to take a fuzzy problem area and independently drive it to state-of-the-art results without day-to-day direction.

Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have

A background in formal verification (Lean, Coq, or Isabelle)
A strong publication record in top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

Our Financial Services Industry Architecture team works on Salesforce’s largest and most complex banking, insurance, and wealth management customers. We don’t stop at showing customers what’s possible; we prove it by building it with them. Success here is a working prototype or a deployed asset, not a great deck.

As a Principal AI & Integrated Solutions Architect, you will be the trusted technical lead for a set of strategic FS accounts. You’ll help design agentic AI architectures that hold up under real scrutiny: governed multi-agent systems, headless and API-first experiences, and unified data and integration patterns that span Agentforce, Data 360, MuleSoft, and the customer’s existing systems. You’ll work across the full engagement. That means framing the problem with C-level and Chief Architect stakeholders, building the prototype that proves the value, and handing it off cleanly to partners and delivery teams so it scales into production and becomes a reusable play for the whole organization.

You’ll sit within an FS segment team and belong to the broader Regulated Industries architecture community. That gives you exposure to patterns and peers across financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and the public sector.

What You’ll Do

Lead agentic AI architecture on strategic accounts (≈30%). Serve as the aligned architect for your accounts. Run discovery and org assessments, set the current- and future-state architecture, and own architectural direction from first conversation through production handoff. Shape decisions on agent orchestration, MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability, headless and composable design, data foundations, and the trust and governance layer.

Build to prove value (≈25%). Co-build working prototypes and proof-of-value assets on customers’ own data and objects, using modern AI-assisted development tools. Turn a hypothesis into something a business sponsor can see and use within weeks, not quarters.

Run and extend our engagement plays (≈15%). Deliver our defined engagement models. These cover the economics of an agentic operating model, headless experiences that keep governance intact, governed multi-agent systems at enterprise scale, and executive North Star architecture. Add new content and reusable components back to the shared library, so each engagement leaves the next one further ahead.

Own the handoff and the path to scale (≈10%). Package architecture, data dictionaries, process maps, and agent metadata so that partners, SIs, and delivery teams can take the work to production without losing the design intent. Hold clear entry and exit gates so delivery stays planned and predictable.

Advise executives on FS outcomes (≈10%). Translate architecture into business value for CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and line-of-business leaders. Fit designs to FS regulatory, data residency, model risk, and operating-model constraints. Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, architecture review boards, and industry events.

Elevate the team and the field (≈10%). Mentor architects and account teams. Contribute points of view, reference architectures, and reusable assets. Work closely with AEs, SEs, Professional Services, forward-deployed engineers, partners, and product teams, with each role doing its own job well.

Architecture-sourced pipeline and measurable progression on priority opportunities in your accounts.

Agentforce and Data 360 consumption milestones reached and tied to customer outcomes.

Prototypes that convert into production commitments and reusable plays adopted by other architects.

Customers who treat you as their go-to architecture advisor, shown by repeat engagement and sponsorship from executive and Chief Architect stakeholders.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

Our Financial Services Industry Architecture team works on Salesforce’s largest and most complex banking, insurance, and wealth management customers. We don’t stop at showing customers what’s possible; we prove it by building it with them. Success here is a working prototype or a deployed asset, not a great deck.

As a Principal AI & Integrated Solutions Architect, you will be the trusted technical lead for a set of strategic FS accounts. You’ll help design agentic AI architectures that hold up under real scrutiny: governed multi-agent systems, headless and API-first experiences, and unified data and integration patterns that span Agentforce, Data 360, MuleSoft, and the customer’s existing systems. You’ll work across the full engagement. That means framing the problem with C-level and Chief Architect stakeholders, building the prototype that proves the value, and handing it off cleanly to partners and delivery teams so it scales into production and becomes a reusable play for the whole organization.

You’ll sit within an FS segment team and belong to the broader Regulated Industries architecture community. That gives you exposure to patterns and peers across financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and the public sector.

What You’ll Do

Lead agentic AI architecture on strategic accounts (≈30%). Serve as the aligned architect for your accounts. Run discovery and org assessments, set the current- and future-state architecture, and own architectural direction from first conversation through production handoff. Shape decisions on agent orchestration, MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability, headless and composable design, data foundations, and the trust and governance layer.

Build to prove value (≈25%). Co-build working prototypes and proof-of-value assets on customers’ own data and objects, using modern AI-assisted development tools. Turn a hypothesis into something a business sponsor can see and use within weeks, not quarters.

Run and extend our engagement plays (≈15%). Deliver our defined engagement models. These cover the economics of an agentic operating model, headless experiences that keep governance intact, governed multi-agent systems at enterprise scale, and executive North Star architecture. Add new content and reusable components back to the shared library, so each engagement leaves the next one further ahead.

Own the handoff and the path to scale (≈10%). Package architecture, data dictionaries, process maps, and agent metadata so that partners, SIs, and delivery teams can take the work to production without losing the design intent. Hold clear entry and exit gates so delivery stays planned and predictable.

Advise executives on FS outcomes (≈10%). Translate architecture into business value for CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and line-of-business leaders. Fit designs to FS regulatory, data residency, model risk, and operating-model constraints. Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, architecture review boards, and industry events.

Elevate the team and the field (≈10%). Mentor architects and account teams. Contribute points of view, reference architectures, and reusable assets. Work closely with AEs, SEs, Professional Services, forward-deployed engineers, partners, and product teams, with each role doing its own job well.

What success looks like

Architecture-sourced pipeline and measurable progression on priority opportunities in your accounts.

Agentforce and Data 360 consumption milestones reached and tied to customer outcomes.

Prototypes that convert into production commitments and reusable plays adopted by other architects.

Customers who treat you as their go-to architecture advisor, shown by repeat engagement and sponsorship from executive and Chief Architect stakeholders.

Disciplined engagement records, so your impact is visible and credited .

What You’ll Bring

10+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, including significant customer-facing work in financial services: banking, insurance, wealth/asset management, or payments.
Deep hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform (Financial Services Cloud, Service/Sales Cloud, Data 360) and enterprise integration, ideally MuleSoft and API-led design.
Practical, current experience designing and building AI solutions. This includes LLM-based agents, retrieval and grounding, agent orchestration, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.
Builder credibility. You personally prototype using code (Apex, JavaScript/Node, Python, or similar) and AI-assisted development tools, and you’re comfortable working in Git-based workflows.
Working knowledge of FS regulatory and risk requirements: privacy, data residency, model risk management, auditability, and AI governance. You also know how these requirements shape architecture decisions.
Executive presence. You can hold a contested architecture debate with a Chief Architect and move it to a decision.
A team-first operating style. You’re comfortable working within aligned coverage, sharing assets, and making others better.

Nice To Have

Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Application/System Architect, or progress toward CTA.
Experience on the customer or SI side of large FS transformations.
Exposure to process intelligence or agentic operations tooling.
Published points of view, conference talks, or open reusable assets.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . added.title: BizApps Data/AI Lead Architect
added.description:
Introduction

Why this role matters

Every Dynamics 365 programme creates a wealth of financial, supply chain and customer data. The organisations that win are the ones that turn that data into trusted insight and, increasingly, into AI that acts on it. Our clients' leaders want to know what their data can tell them, whether they can trust it and how AI can make their business faster and smarter. They need someone who understands Dynamics 365 data inside out and can answer those questions with clarity and credibility.

Come join us

As Lead Data & AI Architect in our global ERP Centre of Excellence, you will be the link between Avanade's Business Applications and Data & AI Solution Areas. Avanade has a large, dedicated Data & AI practice with its own strategies, platforms and offerings. Your role is not to reinvent those within Business Applications, but to bring them to Dynamics 365: aligning, adapting and applying them so our clients get one joined-up approach. You will lead our global Dynamics 365 Data & AI Community of Practice, support our project teams as their senior data and AI expert, and be the person executives call when they want to understand what their ERP and CRM data can do for them.

How You Will Work

This role supports both solutioning (presales) and delivery. When a strategic programme needs it, you may be assigned to a single project as its lead data and AI architect for a longer period. However, our preferred way of working is different: your greatest impact comes from working across our whole portfolio as the senior data and AI expert our own project teams can rely on. In practice, that means:

Acting as the go-to data and AI expert for our Dynamics 365 project teams across all regions, available for design reviews, second opinions and advice on reporting, analytics and AI questions.
Running quality assurance on the data, reporting and AI elements of in-flight programmes, with reviews at key moments so that risks are spotted and addressed early.
Stepping in for short, focused engagements to help solve complex problems, from Fabric and Power BI performance issues to data integration and AI solution challenges.
Leading recovery activities when the analytics or AI part of a programme is in trouble: stabilising the solution, restoring client confidence and handing back a healthy project.
Overseeing the work of the data and BI architects on our Dynamics 365 projects, reviewing their key decisions, coaching them and keeping their approaches aligned with Avanade's Data & AI standards.
Shaping the data, analytics and AI elements of major pursuits together with the Data & AI practice, including solution design, estimates and risks, so that what we sell is what we can deliver.

What You Will Do

Be the bridge between Business Applications and Data & AI

Act as the link between Avanade's Business Applications and Data & AI Solution Areas, the person who makes the two practices work as one for Dynamics 365 clients.
Take Avanade's Data & AI strategies, offerings and reference architectures as the starting point, and align and adjust them for Dynamics 365 rather than inventing separate approaches within Business Applications.
Bring Dynamics 365 knowledge into the Data & AI practice, so that its architects understand ERP and CRM data, Dataverse and the AI capabilities built into Dynamics 365.
Bring the right Data & AI experts into Dynamics 365 pursuits and programmes, and make sure joint solutioning and delivery run smoothly.

Architect data and analytics for Dynamics 365

Own the data and analytics architecture for Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management and Customer Engagement solutions, building on Avanade's Data & AI reference architectures and adapting them to the Dynamics 365 data model.
Design modern analytics platforms on Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory and Real-Time Intelligence), connected to Dynamics 365 through Fabric Link, Synapse Link for Dataverse and the Dataverse data platform.
Lead the design of Power BI solutions: semantic models, DAX, embedded analytics in Dynamics 365, financial and operational reporting, and performance tuning for enterprise scale.
Make sure Dynamics 365 data is fit for analytics and AI, with clear ownership, data quality rules and well-defined business semantics.
Put governance, security and lineage at the centre of every design, using Microsoft Purview, row-level security and sensible capacity and cost management.
Modernise legacy reporting estates, such as BYOD, entity store and older BI platforms, into a Fabric-first architecture.

Turn data into AI that delivers value

Identify and shape AI use cases across finance, supply chain and customer processes, from forecasting and anomaly detection to Copilot experiences and autonomous agents.
Design solutions with Copilot in Dynamics 365 and Power BI, Copilot Studio, Fabric data agents, Microsoft Foundry and Azure OpenAI, grounded in trusted, well-governed business data.
Make client data AI-ready, with the right models, semantics and controls so that AI answers can be trusted and explained.
Embed responsible AI, privacy and compliance in every solution, and help clients set up governance that keeps pace with innovation.

Be the trusted data and AI voice at C-level

Engage CFOs, COOs, CIOs and chief data officers on data strategy, analytics roadmaps and AI investment decisions.
Translate complex data and AI topics into clear, concise updates and stories that show business value, risks and next steps, and that build lasting trust.
Help leadership teams define the KPIs and insights that matter, and show them how a modern data platform will deliver them.
Act as senior escalation point and adviser to Avanade leadership for data and analytics on critical programmes.

Lead the Dynamics 365 Data & AI Community of Practice

Lead the global Dynamics 365 Data & AI Community of Practice, whose purpose is to align Dynamics 365 data and AI work with Avanade's wider Data & AI practice, bringing together BI specialists, data engineers and AI practitioners from both Solution Areas.
Run regular community calls and joint sessions with the Data & AI practice, translating its strategies, offerings and roadmaps into what they mean for Dynamics 365 clients and projects.
Adopt Avanade's Data & AI reference architectures, data models and accelerators and adapt them for Dynamics 365, rather than building parallel assets within Business Applications.
Coach and develop data and AI talent across the practice, and help build a clear career path for data specialists in Business Applications.

Connect Avanade with Microsoft and Accenture

Build strong relationships with Microsoft's Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Fabric and Power BI product teams, bringing preview programmes and roadmap insight to the community and feeding real client experience back.
Work with Accenture's data and AI communities, and with Microsoft's partner teams, so that Dynamics 365 scenarios are part of our joint data and AI offerings and go-to-market.
Represent Avanade at Microsoft and industry events, and through points of view and thought leadership on data and AI in business applications.

Qualifications

Skills and Experience

Delivery Experience

Long experience with Microsoft Dynamics, typically 12 years or more across Dynamics AX, Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management and Dataverse-based applications, including several full-lifecycle enterprise implementations.
A strong track record designing and delivering data, reporting and analytics solutions on Microsoft BI tools for Dynamics 365 clients.
Experience working across organisational boundaries, bringing business applications and data and analytics teams together around one approach.
A background in consulting or systems integration, with experience leading distributed delivery teams.

Data, analytics and AI expertise

Deep understanding of the Dynamics 365 data model, data entities and Dataverse, and of the options for making Dynamics 365 data available to analytics and AI platforms.
Expert command of Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, performance optimisation and governance at enterprise scale.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including Fabric Link, Synapse Link for Dataverse, Data Factory, Lakehouse and Warehouse.
Practical knowledge of Microsoft AI: Copilot in Dynamics 365 and Power BI, Copilot Studio, Fabric data agents, Microsoft Foundry and Azure OpenAI.
Strong grasp of data governance, security and lineage, ideally with Microsoft Purview.
A good understanding of finance and supply chain processes and the KPIs that matter to business leaders.

Leadership and communication

Genuine executive presence: you can hold your own with a CFO or chief data officer and still go deep with a data engineering team.
The ability to turn complex data and AI topics into concise, compelling C-level updates that build trust and lead to decisions.
Experience building and energising communities, and a natural instinct to share what you know.
A collaborative, consultative style, intellectual curiosity and a strong sense of ownership.
Fluent English; additional languages are a plus.

Nice to have

Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Power BI Data Analyst Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate or Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert.
Microsoft MVP status or a visible profile as a speaker or author in the data, Power BI or Dynamics community.
Experience with sustainability, ESG or industry-specific data solutions built on Dynamics 365.

What Success Looks Like After 12 Months

You are recognised by clients, delivery leads and Microsoft as the go-to authority for data and AI on Dynamics 365 at Avanade.
Business Applications and Data & AI work from one aligned approach for Dynamics 365: our programmes apply Avanade's Data & AI reference architectures and assets, adapted where Dynamics 365 needs it, instead of parallel solutions.
Project teams actively seek out your reviews and expert support, and data and AI issues on our programmes are resolved quickly under your leadership.
The Data & AI Community of Practice is the active meeting point between Dynamics 365 and Avanade's wider Data & AI practice, with a clear agenda, regular joint sessions and contributions from every region.
Data and AI are a stronger part of our Dynamics 365 proposals, and clients see real AI use cases move into production.
You have strong, active relationships with Avanade's Data & AI leadership, with Microsoft's Dynamics 365, Fabric and Power BI product teams, and with Accenture's data and AI communities.

Why Avanade

Avanade sits at the heart of the Microsoft ecosystem and is majority-owned by Accenture. That gives you something few employers can offer: direct access to Microsoft product teams, the reach of Accenture's global delivery network, and a Business Applications practice made up of people who genuinely love this platform. You will work on programmes that matter to the clients who run them, alongside colleagues who will challenge you, back you and learn from you.

A global role with real influence on how Avanade delivers Dynamics 365 around the world.
Early access to Microsoft roadmaps, previews and product engineering conversations.
Generous investment in your learning, including paid Microsoft certifications and dedicated training time every year.
A dedicated career advisor and a clear path into the most senior technical leadership roles.
An inclusive, international community where your expertise is valued and your ideas are acted on.

Ready to take the lead?

If you know Dynamics 365 data inside out, love turning it into insight and AI, enjoy bringing two strong practices together, and can explain it all to a boardroom with confidence, we would love to talk to you. Bring your experience and your curiosity, and help us shape the future of

Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, cloud architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 3+ years dedicated to building and deploying production AI/LLM applications and cloud solutions.

GCP & AI Stack: Hands-on mastery of Vertex AI, Gemini APIs, Vector Search, and core GCP infrastructure (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Functions, BigQuery).

LLM & Modern AI Tooling: Practical experience with embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, pgvector), agent frameworks, and LLM orchestration tools.

Programming & IaC: High fluency in Python and/or TypeScript, alongside infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform).

MLOps & DevOps: Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE), model evaluation frameworks, and cost/latency monitoring for AI workloads.

Client-Facing Presence: Exceptional communication and consultative skills, with a demonstrated ability to operate in fast-paced, customer-facing environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Machine Learning Engineer.

Advanced AI Expertise: Experience fine-tuning open-weights models (e.g., Llama, Gemma), implementing custom guardrails, or orchestrating multi-agent systems.

You will own the end-to-end technical vision of complex, multi-module and multi-instance ServiceNow engagements, operating with a high degree of autonomy and minimal day-to-day oversight. Apply ServiceNow's AI platform capabilities, including Now Assist and AI Agent Studio, to design practical Agentic AI use cases for clients.

Establish and enforce technical governance, design authority, and release management practices.
Champion platform health, manageability, and upgrade readiness, minimizing technical debt and custom scope creep on every engagement.

Delivery Leadership & Team Enablement

Own solution delivery across the full project lifecycle, working independently and driving complex work to completion.
Mentor architects, developers, and technical consultants, and partner with functional consultants, project managers, and stakeholders to ensure successful implementations.
Develop high-quality architectural documentation including solution blueprints, integration designs, test plans, and deployment guides.

Platform Architecture

: Demonstrated, hands-on experience designing and building integrations using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub, MID Server, and event-driven patterns. Strong command of JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, and platform design patterns.

added.description:
Job Description

AustralianSuper is the largest superannuation fund in Australia – in the top 20 largest funds globally and top 50 asset owners globally.

With more than US $300 billion in current assets under management, and a world-class investment team, AustralianSuper has the appetite and capability to directly invest in large-scale opportunities.

Our New York office is made up of more than 75 colleagues and is expected to grow significantly over the next few years, so when you join, you become a key part of building our culture.

Your new role

Reporting to the Senior Manager Technology, Americas, the Senior AI & Automation Engineer (Agentic) is a senior hands-on technical specialist responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting AI, automation, and software engineering solutions. The role combines deep technical expertise with practical business understanding to deliver scalable, secure, and supportable solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance colleague experiences, and enable innovation across the Fund.

The position ensures that AI agents and automation solutions align with the Fund’s processes and comply with its architecture and data standards, governance frameworks, security requirements, risk controls, and regulatory obligations. Working collaboratively with Technology, Data, and Digital colleagues—including architects, engineers, delivery teams, and automation specialists—the role embeds intelligent and autonomous capabilities into enterprise platforms and end-to-end business processes.

The Senior AI & Automation Engineer (Agentic) champions continuous improvement through responsible AI and intelligent automation, reducing manual effort, improving decision-making, increasing operational resilience, and translating AI-driven insights into reliable real-world execution. The role also contributes to the development of reusable standards, patterns, guardrails, and best practices that support safe, scalable, explainable, and maintainable solutions.

The successful applicant will be a highly capable technology specialist with strong expertise in AI, automation, software engineering, and solution delivery. They will combine deep technical knowledge with a practical understanding of business needs to design, implement, and continuously improve scalable solutions. As a senior individual contributor, they will provide technical leadership across complex initiatives, contribute to engineering standards and best practices, and support the responsible adoption of AI and automation capabilities across the Fund.

The successful candidate should bring strong financial markets experience gained within an asset manager, institutional investor, or broker-dealer. Experience supporting public and/or private market investment processes is essential, enabling the role to apply AI and automation solutions within investment and trading contexts.

This is a position based on-site at 1251 Avenues of the Americas, with a hybrid schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI and Automation Engineering

Design, build, maintain, and evolve agentic AI and automation systems that support goal-driven planning, reasoning, autonomous task execution, and the execution of business and technology processes across the Fund.
Translate complex business problems into agent-based solution architectures, selecting appropriate models, tools, memory strategies, control mechanisms, and automation patterns.
Develop AI-enabled automation workflows incorporating autonomous decision-making, orchestration, exception handling, adaptive behavior, and safe escalation paths.
Apply agentic automation patterns to reduce reliance on rigid, rule-based processes and improve resilience across complex workflows.
Contribute to the definition and evolution of agentic AI and automation standards, patterns, and best practices within the hyperautomation capability.

Architecture, Orchestration, Integration, and Data

Design and implement agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent, enabling scalable and composable agent solutions.
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines so agent behavior is grounded in trusted, approved, and governed knowledge sources.
Engineer prompts, tool-use patterns, planning strategies, and reasoning approaches to deliver consistent, explainable, and reliable agent outcomes.
Integrate agentic AI and automation solutions with the Fund’s systems and platforms, including core applications, APIs, digital channels, and data services.
Work with Technology, Data, and Digital teams, including architects, engineers, delivery squads, Data Engineering, and Data Services, to align solutions with enterprise architecture, security, data quality, lineage, and governance standards.
Lead solution design activities and provide technical direction for AI, automation, and software engineering solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, data, and operational standards.
Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentoring across AI, automation, and software engineering initiatives, contributing to standards, reusable patterns, and best practices.
Operationalization, Lifecycle, and Service Excellence Operationalize agentic AI and automation solutions using appropriate DevOps and MLOps practices, ensuring reliability, scalability, maintainability, and operational supportability.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI agents and automation assets, from development and deployment through evaluation, optimization, retraining, enhancement, support, and retirement or decommissioning.
Monitor agent and automation behavior for performance, drift, hallucination risk, unintended actions, incidents, and service degradation, implementing mitigation and continuous improvement actions as required.
Ensure solutions are resilient, observable, fit for purpose, and effectively managed within production environments.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

Ensure agentic AI and automation solutions comply with the Fund’s AI and organizational governance frameworks, architectural standards, risk frameworks, security policies, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Design and implement controls, guardrails, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and escalation paths to support safe, responsible, explainable, and auditable autonomous execution.
Identify and mitigate operational, AI, data privacy, security, and regulatory risks associated with intelligent automation.
Contribute to audits, assurance activities, and documentation so solutions meet internal and external compliance expectations.

Stakeholder, Vendor, and Capability Engagement

Collaborate with business, technology, data, and digital stakeholders to understand requirements and identify, assess, and prioritize high-value agentic AI and automation opportunities.
Lead or contribute to ideation, design, and solution workshops that focus on agent-enabled workflows, intelligent decision systems, and automation outcomes.
Partner with vendors and service providers to evaluate, implement, and optimize automation and agentic technologies, supporting value for money and alignment with strategic objectives.
Support AI chapters, centers of excellence, or communities of practice to uplift agentic AI and automation capability and literacy across the Fund.
Communicate solution designs, outcomes, risks, and opportunities clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

What We’re Looking For

Culture is key at AustralianSuper and we are looking for someone who is a team player that enjoys working in a high performing collaborative team.

Essential

8+ years’ experience in hands-on technical engineering roles within complex enterprise environments, delivering robust, scalable, and supportable solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering agentic AI solutions, autonomous workflows, and intelligent automation capabilities, including orchestration, reasoning, planning, memory, tool use, and multi-agent patterns.
Tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical industry experience.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, delivering, and supporting AI-enabled, intelligent automation, or decision support solutions end-to-end in enterprise settings.
Practical experience with agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, goal-driven decision architectures, orchestration, and adaptive automation patterns.
Strong conceptual understanding of Generative AI, large language models, and agent-based system design, including reasoning, planning, memory, and tool use.
Experience designing autonomous solutions with appropriate guardrails, controls, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and escalation paths.
Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 services, and related AI and automation technologies.
Proven ability to own complex technical problems through problem definition, requirements, design, implementation, deployment, optimization, and operational support.
Highly developed analytical, problem-solving, conceptual, abstract, and systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to reason across interconnected technical and business domains.
Ability to operate autonomously, exercise sound engineering judgment, and make informed decisions in ambiguous and evolving environments.
High levels of initiative, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and deliver outcomes under competing demands.
Strong business acumen and understanding of complex enterprise operational contexts.
Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across the full service lifecycle, including requirements discovery, solution design, implementation, deployment, operational support, continuous improvement, and service management.

Desired

Experience applying design thinking principles and/or working within recognized architecture frameworks.
Experience with Azure services, cloud concepts, and cloud-native solution design within a Microsoft ecosystem.
Exposure to regulated environments, such as financial services, superannuation, or insurance, and familiarity with AI governance, risk, ethical, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
Experience working within Agile, Lean, startup, or DevOps delivery models.
Working knowledge of DevOps and MLOps concepts, including CI/CD, monitoring, and model, agent, or automation lifecycle management.
Knowledge of ITIL and service management practices, particularly change, release, incident, and operational management.
Experience with ServiceNow and/or PowerShell scripting.
Strong interest in emerging technologies, particularly AI, agentic systems, automation, and intelligent platforms.
Ability to articulate ideas, influence decisions, present opportunities, and contribute effectively within close-knit, cross functional teams.

Pay transparency notice

At AustralianSuper, we truly care about our colleagues.
