added.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

The Lead Development Product Owner – AI Product Solutions
selected for this position will join AI enablement teams in USAA’s Technology organization.  The candidate will have an opportunity to support a value chain of AI delivery that runs from pilots through production.  The candidate selected for this position will be responsible for serving several AI domains and partnering with peers to manage dependencies and risks across the wider AI value chain. This includes working with multiple delivery teams and stakeholders through all stages of the development lifecycle. 

The candidate selected for this position will be accountable for attaining, understanding, and communicating business needs to manage backlogs of work including guiding teams of Data Scientist and AI Engineers in writing and refining features and stories, planning and prioritizing work, and managing risks to delivery plans. The candidate will also be responsible for ensuring development work adheres to applicable internal software development lifecycle controls. The candidate will demonstrate strong critical thinking, problem solving, and technical knowledge along with an expert ability to work across multiple delivery methodologies to plan and predictably deliver business value.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, or Charlotte, NC. Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Works with business and Subject Matter Experts to understand business strategy and vision and then writes, refines, accepts and prioritizes stories, features or epics to support effective and compliant solutions while balancing investment and business value.
Owns and maintains a prioritized work backlog for a single or multiple Agile teams or program. Product backlog includes complete user stories or features with acceptance criteria so that they are consumable and testable by the Agile team or program. Reviews and accepts output of I/T and/or business development to ensure specified acceptance criteria have been completed.
Serves as a knowledgeable collaborator across multiple business or system domains; is expected to lead development across multiple teams at the program and Epic level.
Serves as direct representative of the business with one or more delivery teams throughout the product delivery cycle.
Participates in a cross-functional team of user experience partners, designers, business analysts, developers, testers and others to develop, execute, solution and release in alignment with program, portfolio or product road maps.
Partners with sponsors, stakeholders, and IT to facilitate, define and document relevant business processes, gaining an expert understanding of the needs, measures, and risks & controls for the improvement area.
Participates with portfolio, program and project level plans related to schedule, scope and resources.
Prepares the business for the change and provides tactics and metrics for benefits, adoption, and risk. Leverages existing change management routines, as needed.
Applies expert knowledge in the business development/execution discipline, regularly seeking out opportunities to enhance, improve and advance the function.
Coaches and mentors less experienced Product Owners, including Seniors.
Demonstrates expert knowledge in multiple business or system domains and capable of leading development across multiple teams at the program level.
Identifies engages, influences and leads business stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts across programs.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
8 years of experience in process improvement, project delivery, business/requirements analysis or directly related to supported business operations/product line.
Expert knowledge of the AI development lifecycle including data science run pilots and engineering run productionalization and hardening with a proven track record in using these skills to develop and manage products through the entire product life cycle.
Expert experience in analyzing business requirements, process flows and use cases to identify opportunities to streamline business processes in accordance with risk management framework and regulatory requirements.
Expert understanding and demonstrated use of Process Engineering methodologies and Change Management practices to translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.
Expert ability to independently work to gather business requirements, process flows and use cases to develop and deliver on business capabilities within the approved methodology, writing user stories, and following the development process through user story acceptance.
Advanced experience analyzing and translating business requirements and proven ability to identify opportunities to streamline business processes in accordance with risk management framework and regulatory requirements.

What Sets You Apart

8 or more years of experience delivering successful AI / Machine Learning (ML) products.
5 or more years of experience in enterprise technology, Data Science, or AI/ML product/program management at a major financial institution.
5 or more years of experience managing delivery team backlog and workflow in systems of record such as JIRA and Clarity.
5 or more years of experience managing execution and delivery of code development, from story writing to production, in a timely and predictable manner.
5 or more years of experience successfully managing development team and/or program-level risks and dependencies across large technology organizations. Including identifying and assessing risks and dependencies, managing and/or mitigating risks and dependencies, documenting risk and dependency statuses, and presenting risk and dependency statuses to leaders and stakeholders.
Technical fluency: comfortable understanding and discussing AI concepts and their derivative business value including working at all phases of the AI lifecycle, managing data requirements, the ability to discuss technical trade-offs and challenges with data scientist and AI engineers, and developing use cases and speaking to how technology deliverables impact stakeholders’ business needs.
Proven ability to decompose features into iterative stories, prioritize stories in a backlog, align the backlog to a sprint cadence, and release planned story work for incremental delivery.
Proven success managing release processes including assessing and documenting testing, determining whether code meets product requirements, presenting working technology in demos, post release validation, and accountability for documenting work completion.
Proven ability to represent AI development with expert verbal and written communication to various audiences including Executive leaders, Director-level stakeholders, business users, IT partners, and development teams.
Experience working with, engaging, and influencing multiple cross-functional teams and leaders including data scientists, engineers, and other personnel across geographically distributed work environments to deliver working technology.
Proven bias towards informed action demonstrated by taking initiative to develop an understanding of ambiguous development challenges and/or stakeholder business needs, planning a path forward, and generating buy-in for quick impactful action.
US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $114,080 - $218,030.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff AI Engineer to join our Information Technology Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineering team, reporting directly to the Senior Manager, AI Engineering, based out of our Santa Clara, CA office on a 3-day hybrid schedule. In this hands-on leadership role, you will serve as the technical lead across two high-impact organizations—the AI Platform group and the AI Solutions and Support group—defining architectural vision, establishing core enterprise infrastructure, such as model gateways and context management, and driving production-grade AI applications and operational workflows across global teams.

Direct technical execution for AI solutions and support, spearheading enterprise AI platform administration, intelligent search experiences, and scalable L2 operational support frameworks
Lead distributed engineering teams across the US and India, aligning roadmap priorities, conducting technical reviews, and fostering seamless communication across time zones
Establish engineering excellence and production AI quality gates, overseeing hands-on code development, CI/CD pipelines, regression suites, and latency and cost optimization
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders in Security, Legal, Privacy, and enterprise business units to ensure compliant, secure, and impactful AI enablement

Who You Are

You are a seasoned technical leader who thrives at the intersection of enterprise architecture, distributed team leadership, and hands-on software engineering.
You possess deep technical breadth in architecting production-grade LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and comprehensive AI evaluation frameworks.
You are an operational driver with a proven track record of reducing systemic friction, resolving production incidents, and automating support processes.
You excel at bridging time zones and cultures, empowering both internal engineers and external partners through empathetic mentorship and clear technical guidance.
You are an articulate communicator and collaborative partner who seamlessly aligns technical strategy with executive stakeholders across business, security, and governance functions.

Demonstrated hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade AI/LLM applications, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, function calling/MCP, and model evaluation or observability frameworks
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of technical leadership experience guiding distributed engineering teams and external contractors across multiple time zones
Proficiency in full-stack development utilizing Python, TypeScript/Node.js (or Java/Go), modern front-end frameworks like React, and robust API design
Hands-on expertise in cloud and containerized infrastructure, including AWS (or GCP/Azure), Docker, Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines
Proven background operating production enterprise services, including incident response, on-call management, runbook development, and SLA governance

Advanced expertise administering enterprise AI platforms (such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI) with comprehensive cost governance, security controls, and usage optimization
Experience architecting vector and graph database solutions, semantic caching, and dynamic long-term agent memory management
Proven success deploying intelligent conversational bots, search experiences, and Slack integrations within enterprise workflows, alongside familiarity with model fine-tuning, open-weight model serving, or compliance standards in regulated environments such as FedRAMP

About Antithesis

We’re on a mission to redefine how modern distributed systems are tested and released. Our platform is trusted by engineering teams who demand rock-solid reliability, scalable performance, and deep technical visibility. Our platform doesn’t just assure system correctness and reliability, it exists because developers need something better. If you’ve ever experienced the pain of a production outage, had a bad week on-call, or had a release delayed by weeks because of one killer bug – you’ll understand exactly why we’re doing what we do. If you're passionate about developer-first products, system resilience, and correctness, we’d love to talk.

About The Role

We’re hiring an Applied AI Software Engineer to build AI native products, integrations, API management, and more, that help our Finance and Accounting teams. Finance here spans FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Payroll, Reporting, SalesOps, Treasury, Equity Management, AP, AR, and Finance/Accounting Ops. The team is moving fast as the company scales, and there’s a big opportunity to automate the remaining manual work and free them up for higher value work.

You’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, data, and Finance operations.

What You’ll Do

Work directly with Finance and Accounting to understand how they work, where they get stuck, and how they could do more with technology.
Design, build, and ship full stack products that use AI to help non technical teams get work done.
Build everything from lightweight agent workflows and automations to production applications for reporting, reconciliation, close support, and other Finance and Accounting problems.
Take manual effort off the team and help shorten the close.
Make pragmatic build versus buy decisions. The right solution might use an existing tool, a reusable agent skill, a custom integration, or a full application.
Support ERP implementation and management, along with other new software implementations and changes coming down the pipe.
Partner with Finance, Accounting, and RevOps to integrate with the systems they use, like our ERP and Salesforce.
Build for the controls Finance needs: testing, monitoring, documentation, version control, audit trails, and access management.
Keep AI work from being siloed. Today it lives with individuals on the team; help turn it into shared tools, reports, and a source of truth that can be maintained and audited as we grow.
Support globalization and the expansion of the Finance team.

Why Join Us?

Join a collaborative, kind team supporting a rapidly growing company.
Work with the resources - tools, teammates, and world-class experts - to do portfolio worthy work.
Use and explore AI in an environment that does not tolerate workslop.

Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including independently shipping and operating production systems.
Experience shipping an LLM powered product, feature, or workflow for real users. You understand the difference between an impressive prototype and a system people can depend on.
Experience working directly with non technical users to understand their workflows, test ideas, and improve products through feedback.
Experience integrating with business systems such as ERP and accounting platforms, Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, or data enrichment platforms.
Strong product and engineering judgment. You can move quickly when the problem calls for an experiment and build for reliability, auditability, and access control when the solution becomes business critical.

Our current stack for internal applications includes TypeScript, React, and AWS. Experience with these tools is helpful, but we care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn.

Start-up experience building from scratch

About The Role

Matter Health is seeking a hands-on, mission-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams—helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most.

Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day-to-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role—not a platform architecture or people management position.

This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in-person meetings or team offsites.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field-based teams to understand day-to-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI-driven automation
Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly
Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations
Submit identified opportunities into the team's intake process and collaborate with the AI Platform Engineer and requesting-team leadership to define priorities
Use approved AI tools, agent platforms, and automation software to configure, build, and deploy workflow automations and AI-assisted processes for operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams
Write and refine prompts and configure workflow logic within existing platform tooling, templates, and standards to automate repetitive day-to-day tasks
Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance
Monitor day-to-day performance of deployed automations and escalate issues related to accuracy, reliability, or unexpected behavior to the AI Platform Engineer or Engineering team
Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations—including those handling protected health information (PHI)
Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI-driven workflows
Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization
Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams
Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, refine, or retire

Qualifications

Required

Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience
1–3 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, workflow automation, or a related operational role
Hands-on experience using AI tools, chatbots, or no-code/low-code automation platforms to build or configure workflows
Strong ability to gather requirements from business and clinical stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency
Comfortable working within established technical standards, prompt and context templates, and controls without needing to design underlying platform architecture
Experience documenting workflows and automation configurations clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
Basic understanding of responsible AI practices and safe handling of sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain new tools clearly to non-technical audiences

Preferred

Experience in the healthcare industry; familiarity with clinical operations, call center or care support workflows, or field-based care models is a plus
Experience with EMR systems, healthcare data, or clinical workflow tools
Familiarity with value-based care, Medicare, or Medicare Advantage environments
Experience supporting distributed, remote, or field-based teams
Background in change management, user training, or internal enablement
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth organization where priorities evolve

What Success Looks Like

Meaningful hours saved for operational, clinical, and field-based teams through deployed automations
Strong adoption of deployed automations by their target teams and users
A growing library of automations successfully built, deployed, and actively maintained in production
Efficient intake-to-launch cycle time from approved automation request to deployment
Collaborative, trusted relationships with clinical and operational stakeholders across the organization
Clear and accessible documentation that enables teams to understand and build on deployed workflows
Active contribution to a growing culture of AI-native thinking across the organization

Why Matter Health

At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

This isn't just a mission statement—it's the work we do every day.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

Working at Matter Health

We're committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally. Benefits for full-time team members begin on the first of the month after your start date.

Health & Wellness

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employer-funded HSA options
Employer-paid life and disability insurance

Access to Matter Health's in-person and virtual care services

Financial Security

401(k) with company match starting on Day 60
Financial wellness resources and support

2 volunteer days annually for meaningful causes

Eligibility is based on full-time employment status. Additional details will be shared during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

added.title: Applied AI Software Engineer
added.description:
About Antithesis

We’re on a mission to redefine how modern distributed systems are tested and released. Our platform is trusted by engineering teams who demand rock-solid reliability, scalable performance, and deep technical visibility. Our platform doesn’t just assure system correctness and reliability, it exists because developers need something better. If you’ve ever experienced the pain of a production outage, had a bad week on-call, or had a release delayed by weeks because of one killer bug – you’ll understand exactly why we’re doing what we do. If you're passionate about developer-first products, system resilience, and correctness, we’d love to talk.

About The Role

We’re hiring an Applied AI Software Engineer to build AI native products, integrations, API management, and more, that help our Finance and Accounting teams. Finance here spans FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Payroll, Reporting, SalesOps, Treasury, Equity Management, AP, AR, and Finance/Accounting Ops. The team is moving fast as the company scales, and there’s a big opportunity to automate the remaining manual work and free them up for higher value work.

You’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, data, and Finance operations.

What You’ll Do

Work directly with Finance and Accounting to understand how they work, where they get stuck, and how they could do more with technology.
Design, build, and ship full stack products that use AI to help non technical teams get work done.
Build everything from lightweight agent workflows and automations to production applications for reporting, reconciliation, close support, and other Finance and Accounting problems.
Take manual effort off the team and help shorten the close.
Make pragmatic build versus buy decisions. The right solution might use an existing tool, a reusable agent skill, a custom integration, or a full application.
Support ERP implementation and management, along with other new software implementations and changes coming down the pipe.
Partner with Finance, Accounting, and RevOps to integrate with the systems they use, like our ERP and Salesforce.
Build for the controls Finance needs: testing, monitoring, documentation, version control, audit trails, and access management.
Keep AI work from being siloed. Today it lives with individuals on the team; help turn it into shared tools, reports, and a source of truth that can be maintained and audited as we grow.
Support globalization and the expansion of the Finance team.

Why Join Us?

Join a collaborative, kind team supporting a rapidly growing company.
Work with the resources - tools, teammates, and world-class experts - to do portfolio worthy work.
Use and explore AI in an environment that does not tolerate workslop.

Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including independently shipping and operating production systems.
Experience shipping an LLM powered product, feature, or workflow for real users. You understand the difference between an impressive prototype and a system people can depend on.
Experience working directly with non technical users to understand their workflows, test ideas, and improve products through feedback.
Experience integrating with business systems such as ERP and accounting platforms, Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, or data enrichment platforms.
Strong product and engineering judgment. You can move quickly when the problem calls for an experiment and build for reliability, auditability, and access control when the solution becomes business critical.

Our current stack for internal applications includes TypeScript, React, and AWS. Experience with these tools is helpful, but we care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn.

Nice to Have

CPA
Start-up experience building from scratch

added.title: Principal/Distinguished, Applied AI Architect — Financial Services Regulated Industries Architecture (Internal Only)
added.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

Our Financial Services Industry Architecture team works on Salesforce’s largest and most complex banking, insurance, and wealth management customers. We don’t stop at showing customers what’s possible; we prove it by building it with them. Success here is a working prototype or a deployed asset, not a great deck.

As a Principal AI & Integrated Solutions Architect, you will be the trusted technical lead for a set of strategic FS accounts. You’ll help design agentic AI architectures that hold up under real scrutiny: governed multi-agent systems, headless and API-first experiences, and unified data and integration patterns that span Agentforce, Data 360, MuleSoft, and the customer’s existing systems. You’ll work across the full engagement. That means framing the problem with C-level and Chief Architect stakeholders, building the prototype that proves the value, and handing it off cleanly to partners and delivery teams so it scales into production and becomes a reusable play for the whole organization.

You’ll sit within an FS segment team and belong to the broader Regulated Industries architecture community. That gives you exposure to patterns and peers across financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and the public sector.

What You’ll Do

Lead agentic AI architecture on strategic accounts (≈30%). Serve as the aligned architect for your accounts. Run discovery and org assessments, set the current- and future-state architecture, and own architectural direction from first conversation through production handoff. Shape decisions on agent orchestration, MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability, headless and composable design, data foundations, and the trust and governance layer.

Build to prove value (≈25%). Co-build working prototypes and proof-of-value assets on customers’ own data and objects, using modern AI-assisted development tools. Turn a hypothesis into something a business sponsor can see and use within weeks, not quarters.

Run and extend our engagement plays (≈15%). Deliver our defined engagement models. These cover the economics of an agentic operating model, headless experiences that keep governance intact, governed multi-agent systems at enterprise scale, and executive North Star architecture. Add new content and reusable components back to the shared library, so each engagement leaves the next one further ahead.

Own the handoff and the path to scale (≈10%). Package architecture, data dictionaries, process maps, and agent metadata so that partners, SIs, and delivery teams can take the work to production without losing the design intent. Hold clear entry and exit gates so delivery stays planned and predictable.

Advise executives on FS outcomes (≈10%). Translate architecture into business value for CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and line-of-business leaders. Fit designs to FS regulatory, data residency, model risk, and operating-model constraints. Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, architecture review boards, and industry events.

Elevate the team and the field (≈10%). Mentor architects and account teams. Contribute points of view, reference architectures, and reusable assets. Work closely with AEs, SEs, Professional Services, forward-deployed engineers, partners, and product teams, with each role doing its own job well.

What success looks like

Architecture-sourced pipeline and measurable progression on priority opportunities in your accounts.

Agentforce and Data 360 consumption milestones reached and tied to customer outcomes.

Prototypes that convert into production commitments and reusable plays adopted by other architects.

Customers who treat you as their go-to architecture advisor, shown by repeat engagement and sponsorship from executive and Chief Architect stakeholders.

Disciplined engagement records, so your impact is visible and credited .

What You’ll Bring

10+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, including significant customer-facing work in financial services: banking, insurance, wealth/asset management, or payments.
Deep hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform (Financial Services Cloud, Service/Sales Cloud, Data 360) and enterprise integration, ideally MuleSoft and API-led design.
Practical, current experience designing and building AI solutions. This includes LLM-based agents, retrieval and grounding, agent orchestration, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.
Builder credibility. You personally prototype using code (Apex, JavaScript/Node, Python, or similar) and AI-assisted development tools, and you’re comfortable working in Git-based workflows.
Working knowledge of FS regulatory and risk requirements: privacy, data residency, model risk management, auditability, and AI governance. You also know how these requirements shape architecture decisions.
Executive presence. You can hold a contested architecture debate with a Chief Architect and move it to a decision.
A team-first operating style. You’re comfortable working within aligned coverage, sharing assets, and making others better.

Nice To Have

Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Application/System Architect, or progress toward CTA.
Experience on the customer or SI side of large FS transformations.
Exposure to process intelligence or agentic operations tooling.
Published points of view, conference talks, or open reusable assets.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

About The Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

At Capgemini Invent, the Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team helps organizations unlock the full value of their data and AI investments to drive meaningful, scalable change. As part of Capgemini's Strategy & Transformation Consulting practice, DDT partners with clients to shape data-centric strategies, modern operating models, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Our unified team model brings together expertise across Data & AI Advisory, Data Platforms & Architecture, and Applied Data Fusion, enabling seamless collaboration from strategy through execution.

Your Role

You will lead complex AI programs, senior technical relationships, practice standards, and capability development.

Lead multi-system AI programs.
Own CTO and Chief Architect relationships.
Set engineering and evaluation standards.
Develop senior engineers and leaders.
Drive thought leadership.

You are able to identify and support AI-enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI-augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development.
